raw.excerpt: ABOUT onXWe’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors.
raw.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Manager of Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & Revenue Growth) to build and lead a new function within our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team. This team will focus on improving the experience of paying subscribers, increasing engagement, growing customer lifetime value, and strengthening retention through data-driven lifecycle marketing programs.

In this role, you'll lead a team of three marketers and shape how our Retention & Revenue Growth function operates. You'll translate business objectives into a cohesive approach to post-purchase engagement and revenue growth, establish priorities and ways of working, and guide the team in developing programs that drive measurable improvements in subscriber behavior. You'll navigate competing opportunities, make informed trade-offs, and work across teams to build solutions that scale.

This is an opportunity to build a new function while developing a high-performing team. You'll establish a strong foundation for experimentation, measurement, and continuous improvement, while advancing thoughtful AI adoption and helping your team develop the capabilities to work more effectively and independently. As the business evolves, the function may also expand into emerging opportunities such as community-driven growth and sharing.

ABOUT THE GROWTH LIFECYCLE MARKETING TEAM

Our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team operates with a high degree of end-to-end ownership. We use customer behavior and data to identify opportunities, develop strategies, build and launch lifecycle experiences, measure performance, and turn what we learn into the next experiment. Rather than routinely handing work from one function to another, our lifecycle marketers have the tools and autonomy to move work forward themselves while partnering with teams across onX where their expertise is needed.

We move quickly, experiment often, and stay close to both the customer experience and the results of our work. That means being strategic and hands-on aren't separate parts of the job—they go together.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Team Leadership & Development: Build and lead a team of three marketers, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, performance expectations, and operating practices for a new function. Develop team members through coaching, feedback, and meaningful ownership, strengthening their ability to independently navigate complex work, make sound decisions, and deliver measurable results. Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Functional Strategy & Prioritization: Translate broader business objectives and customer insights into a cohesive retention and revenue growth approach. Establish the team's roadmap, identify and evaluate opportunities, and make informed decisions about priorities, resources, and trade-offs. Balance near-term performance with longer-term improvements while adapting plans as business needs and customer behaviors evolve.
  • Post-Purchase Lifecycle: Lead the development and ongoing improvement of lifecycle marketing programs that strengthen the paying subscriber experience. Guide the team in identifying customer needs, designing relevant experiences, and optimizing programs across email, push, and in-app messaging to drive meaningful behavior change.
  • Revenue Growth: Lead a coordinated approach to growing revenue from existing subscribers, including upsell, churn prevention, add-on attachment, cross-sell, and bundling. Evaluate opportunities across these interconnected programs, make deliberate trade-offs, and ensure initiatives work together to improve customer value and business outcomes.
  • Experimentation, Measurement & Optimization: Establish a disciplined experimentation and measurement approach that enables the team to test hypotheses, evaluate incremental impact, and make evidence-based decisions. Guide the development of meaningful success measures, strengthen the team's analytical capabilities, and use insights to prioritize improvements, scale successful programs, and retire ineffective approaches.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Build effective partnerships with vertical marketing, Product, Analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders to connect lifecycle initiatives to shared business priorities. Influence program direction, navigate competing needs, and help teams align around customer behavior and measurable outcomes. Identify opportunities to extend successful approaches across verticals while accounting for differences in business maturity and customer needs.
  • AI Fluency & Team Enablement: Advance responsible and effective AI adoption by establishing shared practices, developing team fluency, and helping marketers apply AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. Evaluate opportunities based on stakeholder value, effort, risk, and readiness, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows. Collaborate with peer managers and senior individual contributors to share learning, support consistent evaluation of AI capabilities, and connect specialists with broader expertise and resources. Balance adoption goals with team capacity, workload, and change readiness to ensure improvements are sustainable.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Seven (7) or more years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, or growth marketing within consumer subscription or mobile app businesses, including a minimum of two (2) or more years of people management experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing marketers, building team capabilities, establishing accountability, and empowering individuals to independently own complex work.
  • Experience building or evolving lifecycle marketing programs or functions, including defining priorities, establishing operating practices, and developing scalable approaches to achieving business objectives.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to evaluate competing opportunities, make informed trade-offs, and translate strategic objectives into actionable team priorities.
  • Deep understanding of post-purchase lifecycle marketing, including onboarding, engagement, feature adoption, churn prevention, and expansion revenue.
  • Strong experimentation and analytical capabilities, including experience designing and evaluating A/B and holdout tests, interpreting customer behavior data, and applying insights to improve retention or revenue outcomes.
  • Experience using lifecycle marketing platforms such as Braze and product analytics tools such as Amplitude to guide program development, experimentation, and performance measurement.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment around shared priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Applied experience using AI tools to improve workflows, analysis, or marketing effectiveness, along with the ability to evaluate appropriate use cases, exercise sound judgment over outputs, and help others adopt effective and responsible practices.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX's Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience standing up or scaling expansion revenue motions (upsell, cross-sell, bundling) on a subscription base.
  • Experience partnering with data science teams to deploy propensity or churn models in production campaigns.
  • Experience with referral, sharing, or community-driven growth programs.
  • Experience with SQL/BigQuery for deeper self-serve analysis.
  • Experience with Liquid templating (or similar) for dynamic personalization in Braze.
  • Experience establishing shared AI workflows, evaluating AI-enabled improvements, or supporting adoption across marketing teams.
  • A personal passion for hunting, offroading, backcountry, or fishing, and time spent using the outdoors the way our customers do.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $130,000 and $164,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
  • Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at .

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

raw.description:
Why this role and why now?

Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster. Ultimo is growing rapidly, both globally and in the US, and every North American customer deserves a steady, predictable experience from contract signature to go‑live. That’s why we’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to give each implementation a single, accountable owner.

This is not a status-reporting role. You understand the work well enough to judge whether a project is really on track, and you catch issues while they are still small.

If you enjoy ownership, bringing structure to fast-moving projects, and shaping how a growing team delivers, this is your moment.

Your impact

As Project Manager, Technical & Functional, you own the plan, budget, risks, and communication for Ultimo implementations across North America. A customer’s maintenance director and IT lead should each see you as someone who understands their side of the project, from work orders and preventive maintenance to data, integrations, and cutover.

You are trusted to lead the project, not just to track it.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own scope, plan, budget, resourcing, risks, and issues for North American implementations, from sales handover through go‑live and transition to support
  • Receive the sales-to-delivery handover, confirm nothing promised is undocumented, and run the customer kickoff
  • Run a consistent communication cadence for customers, internal teams, and subcontractors: weekly status, a shared risk and issue log, steering committees, and clear escalation paths
  • Own the change order process, identifying scope change early and securing customer approval before work proceeds
  • Act as the single point of contact for support tickets raised on active projects and track each one to resolution
  • Coordinate consultants, the Solution Architect, the data migration lead, and internal Ultimo services such as our European practice and product specialists as one team
  • Plan and run cutover, go/no‑go decisions, hypercare, and the formal handover to support
  • Help build the North American delivery playbook, and use AI tools to reduce administrative effort
  • Close projects in a way that turns customers into references

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of experience managing EAM / CMMS / ERP implementations for asset-intensive organizations (IBM Maximo, IFS, SAP PM, MainSaver, or similar)
  • Have strong domain knowledge in maintenance work processes, preventive maintenance, inventory, and reliability, and can discuss them with plant and maintenance leaders
  • Understand data migration, integrations, and cutover well enough to plan them, judge progress, and ask the right questions
  • Have managed fixed-price and time-and-materials projects, raised change orders, and protected margin without damaging the relationship
  • Stay calm under pressure, have stabilized a strained project, and deliver difficult messages clearly
  • Enjoy turning ad hoc ways of working into simple, repeatable standards that a growing team will actually use
  • Have an affinity with AI and emerging technologies, and use AI tools in your daily work
  • Communicate confidently and clearly with customers and internal stakeholders
  • Take ownership and act proactively, with a genuine commitment to customer success

Ready to step up?

If you’re looking for a role where customers rely on you to keep their implementation on course, and where you can shape how a growing team delivers, this is the opportunity.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites for kickoffs, steering committees, and go‑live.

Apply now and help organizations get more out of their assets faster.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer

  • You work in a pragmatic, result-driven culture with experienced professionals

raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?


We are seeking a highly skilled, technically proficient and detail-oriented Sr.Principal Technical Program Manager within the Intelligent Infrastructure Segment to lead the architecture, integration, and delivery of advanced air and liquid‑cooled server rack solutions for large-scale deployments.


This role is critical in translating hyperscale data center requirements into robust, scalable, and manufacturable systems for next-gen AI/ML (GPU/CPU), cloud infrastructure, and network deployments. This person will oversee end‑to‑end rack development – from scoping and initial architecture review of customer requirements, through validation and deployment.


This person will also drive cross‑functional collaboration, technical innovation, and continuous improvement across multiple datacenter programs.

What will you do?

  • Lead complex, multi‑disciplinary hardware programs – coordinating mechanical, thermal, electrical, networking, supply chain, and manufacturing teams – while aligning requirements, driving schedules, and ensuring successful delivery of integrated rack, network, and cooling solutions
  • Provides regular updates to senior leadership, external partners, and internal teams on the status of infrastructure programs, including risks, blockers, and dependencies
  • Displays in depth knowledge of datacenter environment – rack integration/delivery, custom rack/manifold/liquid cooling product development, and related systems
  • Coordinate multiple projects and reconcile interdependencies among them
  • Drive decisions with appropriate stakeholders, eliminating roadblocks to resolve customer issues
  • Adept at managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating schedules
  • Collaborate with factory-based PMs to provide support from RFP through NPI completion of FWT
  • Manage RFP timelines, milestones, meetings, document repository, RFIs / ECNs and team up in packaging all RFP deliverables
  • Participate in customer engagements and site visits to understand deployment constraints (white-glove services) and gather feedback for design improvements.
  • Manage relationships with mechanical component vendors, including rack, PDUs, switches, cables, and packaging solutions.
  • Collaborate with compliance, shock/vibe, and certification teams to ensure mechanical designs meet global regulatory requirements (e.g., UL, CE, ISTA, ASTM).
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

How will you get here?


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field is required

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10+ years’ experience in mechanical systems integration. This could include high-density server / rack design and integration, including end-to-end delivery for large-scale deployments worldwide
  • 6+ years of project management experience, involving scope determination, scheduling, budgeting, quality, risk and critical path management, cross-functional collaboration, and leading presentations with customers and stakeholders.
  • 3+ years focused on data center related projects, with preference on rack hardware for hyperscale customers
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills – a must
  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, integration strategies, and program management

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Proven track record of taking ownership and delivering results in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and dynamic environment
  • Proficiency in Agile, Scrum, and/or Waterfall methodologies
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Creative, self-motivated, accountable, and team-oriented
  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight
  • Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides
  • Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries
  • Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices
  • Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones
  • Familiar with stage-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLCM)
  • Able to coach and mentor less experienced engineers
  • Ability to travel both domestically and internationally up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Master’s Degree
  • PMP Certification
  • Hands-on experience with prototype fabrication and testing; experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers (CM) a plus.

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
  • 401K Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Annual Merit Increases
  • Community Volunteer Opportunities
The pay range for this role is $164,200 - $295,600. Job-related, non-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity. The anticipated close date of this job requisition is: November 01, 2026.As part of the total rewards package, this position is eligible for a short-term incentive based on performance. In addition, Jabil offers benefits to enhance your health, wealth, and resilient self. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; paid time off accruing at a rate of 3.07 hours during your first year of employment; 4 weeks of paid parental leave; in 2027, 11 company-paid holidays (9 fixed holidays and 2 optional floating holidays), subject to change yearly; 401(k) retirement plan; and employee stock purchase plan.BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Evaluation Systems of Pearson offers dynamic teacher licensing and performance assessment solutions. Our custom teacher licensure testing programs are 100 percent aligned to state standards. Scoring offers the opportunity to network with other professionals and stay abreast of the latest developments in your field. Scorers have a direct impact on the quality of the next generation of teachers and help to maintain professional standards. Scorers enjoy the change of pace, the mental challenge, and the opportunity to give back to their educational field.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher, and
  • A current teaching certification in the subject area you are applying for AND be practicing or have five (5) or more years’ recent experience in the service role in a public school in the subject area you are applying for

OR

  • Basic computer skills (keyboard, mouse)

Key benefits

Senior Frontend Technical Lead - React & Integrations

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Senior Frontend Technical Lead — React & Integrations

Location preference: Denver, CO (Open for Remote)

Position Summary

  • We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Web Developer – React / Node.js to take ownership of web application architecture, hands-on development, and technical delivery for a high-impact web team. This is a hands-on coding role requiring deep expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Express, along with the ability to guide developers, make sound architecture decisions, and deliver scalable, production-grade web applications.
  • In this role, you will lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of web applications integrated with restaurant technology ecosystems, while partnering closely with clients, product teams, IT leadership, marketing, and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of scalable web applications.
  • Own and drive the overall web application architecture, frontend strategy, and technical roadmap.
  • Actively code features and user stories, review code, resolve defects, and provide hands-on support throughout delivery.
  • Develop and maintain multiple pages and application experiences using React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and Express.
  • Design scalable React applications using modern frontend architecture principles, including headless architecture, atomic design, state management, API integration, error handling, and performance optimization.
  • Integrate web applications with restaurant technology ecosystems, including:
  • Online ordering platforms
  • POS systems
  • Payment providers
  • Loyalty and rewards platforms
  • Customer identity and authentication solutions
  • Location services
  • Push notifications
  • Promotions and offers
  • Analytics and customer engagement platforms
  • Apply end-to-end solution thinking to ensure frontend decisions support backend services, databases, reporting, accounting, and downstream business processes.
  • Lead third-party integrations involving POS platforms, payment systems, commerce platforms, and other business-critical external systems.
  • Identify technical gaps, challenge assumptions, guide developers, review designs and code, and make decisions based on the complete solution.
  • Assess delivery risks, manage technical dependencies, coordinate testing, and prepare applications for production releases.
  • Partner effectively with IT Directors, Product Management, Marketing, and development team members to plan roadmaps and deliver solutions.
  • Establish and promote coding standards, development best practices, architecture patterns, documentation practices, and technical guidelines.
  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code with a focus on consistency and long-term maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and optimize existing applications.
  • Ensure application performance, quality, responsiveness, availability, and customer experience.
  • Monitor application performance, crashes, availability, and customer experience metrics using tools such as DataDog, Splunk, App Insights, New Relic, or similar platforms.
  • Support CI/CD practices and contribute to efficient release processes.
  • Develop and maintain unit testing frameworks and quality practices.
  • Apply knowledge of application security and networking to build reliable, secure solutions.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and modern engineering practices to support continuous innovation.
  • Bring a consulting mindset, strong client communication, and effective presentation skills to technical discussions and delivery engagements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software or web development experience, including significant experience building production-grade web applications.
  • 5+ years of recent hands-on coding experience with React.js; coding assessment will be conducted.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years in a Lead Web Developer, Tech Lead, or similar technical leadership role.
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js and Express.
  • 3+ years of experience leading and mentoring Developers and Senior Developers.
  • 2+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining multi-page applications in React.js.
  • Full stack familiarity, including backend technologies such as Node.js and related services.
  • Strong experience with HTML5, CSS, and CSS preprocessors such as LESS and SASS.
  • Advanced knowledge of command line build utilities and task runners such as npm, webpack, grunt, and gulp.
  • Advanced knowledge of accessibility standards.
  • Real-time working experience with asynchronous requests, API integrations, partial page updates, SEO optimization, SSR, and page performance troubleshooting and optimization.
  • Expert-level understanding of version control systems, including Git.
  • Proven experience with CI/CD practices.
  • Track record developing unit testing frameworks.
  • Competency in application security and networking.
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud Functions.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and planning technical roadmaps.
  • Ability to assess risks, manage dependencies, coordinate testing, and support successful production releases.
  • Strong documentation discipline, commitment to consistency and reusability, and the ability to see the big picture.
  • Strong consulting, client communication, and presentation skills.
  • Practical judgment, attention to scope management, and a collaborative approach to solving delivery challenges.
  • Experience integrating restaurant POS platforms is a plus.
  • Experience in restaurant technology, retail, hospitality, or e-commerce is a plus.

The base salary for this position is $106,087 to $140,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

raw.title: Python & Java Full Stack Developer (AI-Assisted)
raw.excerpt: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions.
raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?


  • As the Python & Java Full Stack Developer, you will build AI-assisted platforms for manufacturing tests and debug automation software with direct, real-world consequences on the factory floor.
  • You will own end-to-end features across event-driven platforms, from cloud infrastructure and backend microservices, up through an agentic LLM pipeline, out to a modern web frontend.
  • LLMs are a core building block of what we build, and AI coding agents are a core part of how we build it but we treat them as power tools operated by strong engineers, not autopilots.
  • This role requires someone who can define work with precision, critically evaluate agent-generated output, and write code themselves when needed.
  • As the Python & Java Full Stack Developer (AI-Capabilities), you are equally comfortable writing a Python Lambda handler, designing an agent tool, building a Java microservice, defining infrastructure as code, tuning a message-bus consumer, and building an Angular component with an AI agent working alongside you.

How We Work with AI


  • We use AI coding agents Claude, Kiro, and similar agentic IDEs/CLIs (we use Kiro) but as power tools in the hands of engineers who could do the work without them.
  • We are seeking a passionate developer who has experienced building without AI, understands its capabilities and limitations, and knows when to rely on AI versus writing code themselves.
  • The challenge isn’t generating code. It’s defining requirements precisely and rigorously validating the output.

Engineering Fundamentals

  • You can read, debug, and correct generated code as readily as you can produce it, and you can justify an architectural decision independent of what any tool suggested.

Spec-Driven Development

  • Decompose features into clear requirements, design, and task breakdowns that both humans and agents execute against, treating the spec as the source of truth and iterating on it.

Skills and Powers

  • Author and use reusable agent capabilities (skills, steering docs, custom tools/MCP integrations, project conventions) to encode team standards and make agents productive in a large codebase.

Prompt and Context Engineering

  • Give agents the right context (conventions, contracts, constraints) and validate their output rather than trusting it blindly.

Correctness Discipline

  • Pair agent velocity with strong testing, review, and observability so fast-moving changes stay safe in production.

What will you do?


  • Design, build, and ship feature end-to-end across the full stack AWS infrastructure, Python and Java backend services, agentic LLM workflows, and the Angular frontend for a system serving manufacturing across multiple sites.
  • Build and evolve agentic AI workflows on Amazon Bedrock.

(LLM reasoning + embeddings):

    • tool/function calling, RAG,
    • prompts,
    • validation loops, and
    • fallback strategies that stay correct and observable under production load
  • Own backend services across two ecosystems
    • Python serverless (Lambda, event-driven) and
    • Java microservices (Spring Boot/Quarkus) with REST and event-driven APIs, persistence, async pipelines, and message-bus integrations
    • Care for idempotency, retries, and dead-letter handling throughout
  • Define and evolve infrastructure as code (AWS CDK) across multi-stack deployments with cross-stack references.
  • Treat published API surfaces as backwards-compatibility contracts, using shared interface/schema libraries consumed across services and clients.
  • Develop retrieval and scoring logic:
    • log chunking, embeddings, vector/semantic search in OpenSearch, and relevance ranking
  • Instrument with CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, tracing, structured diagnostic events and own CI/CD on Azure DevOps with gated, reversible rollouts.
  • Contribute to shared foundational code with wide blast radius, keeping changes narrow and well-tested.

How will you get here?


Python

  • Modern typing, async patterns, data validation (e.g., Pydantic), clean error handling, and a codebase-scale sense of structure.

Backend Engineering in Java

  • Deep experience with Spring Boot and/or Quarkus, clean architecture, and idiomatic use of the type system.
  • Production AWS serverless and cloud experience across the stack:

Compute

  • Lambda
  • ECS Fargate

Data & Messaging

  • DynamoDB
  • S3
  • SQS
  • OpenSearch

Networking

  • VPC
  • VPC Endpoints
  • API Gateway (Private)

Eventing & Scheduling

  • EventBridge

Security & Identity

  • IAM
  • IAM Roles Anywhere (trust anchor, cross-environment access)

AI

  • Amazon Bedrock

Ops & Config

  • CloudWatch (alarms + dashboards)
  • SSM Parameter Store
  • ECR assets

Persistence Expertise

  • JPA / Hibernate
  • JDBC
  • transaction management
  • NoSQL data modeling (DynamoDB access patterns),
  • and relational database design, management, and query optimization

API Design

  • Production REST services; comfortable with versioning and backwards-compatibility.

Modern Concurrency

  • Java virtual threads (Project Loom) and reasoning clearly about concurrency correctness.

Microservices & Event-Driven Architecture

  • Designing and operating microservices with a message bus (NATS.io, Kafka, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, retries, and failure handling.

Hands-on LLM/agent Development

  • Building applications with LLMs (function calling, prompt design, RAG, embeddings) and evaluating output quality. You understand that specifying and validating agent behavior is the hard part.

AI-assisted development Practice

  • Daily, judicious use of AI coding agents (Claude, Kiro, etc.), spec-driven workflows, and reusable agent skills/powers, paired with the fundamentals to review their output critically.

Frontend Development in Angular

  • Building and maintaining a modern web UI (Angular/TypeScript) that consumes these APIs.

Testing Discipline

  • Unit, integration, and mocking as a first-class part of shipping.

Containerization & Orchestration

  • Docker and Docker Swarm
  • Kubernetes

Cloud-Native Workflow

  • Git
  • Azure DevOps pipelines
  • and code review in a sizable multi-repo codebase

Deployment Strategies

  • Blue/green, canary, gated rollout, and rollback

Observability, Security & Analytics

  • Structured logging, tracing, metrics; secure coding and auth fundamentals; and building/consuming analytics on operational data.

Education:

  • BS degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field
  • MS preferred

Experience:

  • 10+ years’ experience in a software development capacity with enterprise server, storage or networking products.

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
  • 401K Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance

  • Community Volunteer Opportunities
The pay range for this role is $100,100 - $180,200. Job-related, non-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity. The anticipated close date of this job requisition is: October 25, 2026.As part of the total rewards package, this position is eligible for a short-term incentive based on performance. In addition, Jabil offers benefits to enhance your health, wealth, and resilient self. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; paid time off accruing at a rate of 3.07 hours during your first year of employment; 4 weeks of paid parental leave; in 2027, 11 company-paid holidays (9 fixed holidays and 2 optional floating holidays), subject to change yearly; 401(k) retirement plan; and employee stock purchase plan.BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact the Federal Bureau of Investigations internet crime hotline (www.ic3.gov), the Federal Trade Commission identity theft hotline (www.identitytheft.gov) and/or your local police department. raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Noora Health Bangladesh is part of Noora Health’s broader mission to improve health outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with essential skills to care for their loved ones.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 51.4 million caregivers and patients across 16,000+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tele-supporter is responsible for engaging with patients and their family members through phone calls to onboard them to Noora Health’s mobile Care Companion health education service. The role involves collecting user information, facilitating access to medically reviewed health education on maternal, newborn, and other relevant health conditions, and addressing user queries through coordination with the Medical Team.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

User Onboarding & Health Communication

  • Conduct scheduled outbound calls to assigned patients and caregivers to introduce the Noora Health mobile Care Companion health education service and complete the onboarding process.
  • Collect relevant user information, document responses and call notes, and submit the required data through SurveyCTO.
  • Communicate health education information reviewed by the Medical Team, addressing topics relevant to antenatal and postnatal care, high-risk newborns, hypertension, diabetes, and surgical recovery.

Question Collection & Follow-up

  • Actively listen to patients' and caregivers' questions, concerns, and feedback during calls, and accurately document them for follow-up.
  • Coordinate with the Medical Support Executive (MSE) team to obtain appropriate responses to health-related queries and communicate the responses to the respective users.

Campaign Monitoring & User Feedback

  • Conduct mid-campaign follow-up calls seven days after onboarding to assess message delivery, user engagement, and any questions or concerns.
  • Conduct post-campaign feedback calls to understand users' experience and satisfaction with the service and collect feedback to identify areas for improvement.

Call Documentation & Operational Support

  • Record all calls, upload recordings to the designated Google Drive folders, and maintain accurate call statuses, notes, and follow-up records in the assigned Tracker.
  • Support supervisors with daily call tracking, workflow coordination, reporting, and other administrative or operational tasks as required.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Education: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Public Health, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Psychology, or Nutrition. Candidates with a Bachelor/Master’s of Science (BSc/MSc) in Nursing are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 0-2 years prior experience in tele-calling, call center operations, customer support, counselling, public health interventions, or healthcare delivery is highly preferred.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in standard Bangla with clear pronunciation and articulation. English mixing during calls is not permitted. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Telecommunication Skills: Ability to manage high-volume outbound calls and meet daily call targets, with approximately 90% of working time dedicated to phone-based interactions.
  • Digital Literacy: Proficiency in MS Office (Word and Excel) and digital communication tools such as WhatsApp, Google Drive, Google Meet, and Zoom is required.
  • Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal, active listening, communication, and organisational skills. Demonstrated empathy, adaptability, integrity, and attention to detail, particularly when handling sensitive patient information. Familiarity with basic medical terminology will be an added advantage.

Technical Setup: Must have reliable, high-speed home internet, a personal computer/laptop, and a smartphone in good working condition.

Work Details: Full-time position with a six-day workweek (Saturday to Thursday) and eight-hour daily shifts, including approximately 6.5 hours of active talk time. Flexibility to accommodate program requirements is essential.

WHAT WE VALUE

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we understand the value of developing a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We prioritize diversity within our team, and we welcome candidates from all gender identities, castes, religious practices, sexual orientations, and abilities — among many others.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

raw.excerpt: JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.  Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients.
raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on, highly technical role responsible for securing JLL’s global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings a security-first mindset, a bias towards action, and deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies alongside broad command of API security, WAF/CDN platforms, and complex troubleshooting across network and application layers. You’ll work collaboratively with global engineering, application, and security teams to ensure security controls are intelligence-driven, optimized, and aligned to industry best practices.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Palo Alto Networks technologies (NGFWs, Cloud NGFW, Panorama), Web Application Firewall, Content Delivery Network, API Security, IDS/IPS, and DDoS prevention
  • Own onboarding, policy tuning, and lifecycle management for WAF and CDN platforms; lead firewall ruleset optimization, IDS/IPS tuning, and DDoS protection configuration
  • Partner with internal teams to drive the global rollout, tuning, and operational management of URL filtering and TLS decryption across the network estate
  • Lead API security efforts — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, identifying vulnerabilities, and working with application teams on fixes
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex, multi-layer global network and application issues — from packet captures on inter-continental BGP topologies to WAF false-positive triage
  • Partner with business and application teams to produce clear, actionable security documentation, change proposals, and executive-ready findings
  • Analyze existing network security architectures, processes, and procedures to identify gaps and drive meaningful improvements
  • Configure and report on defensive measures against advanced threat actor tactics; maintain current awareness of the evolving threat landscape and the effectiveness of our defenses against them
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both global engineering teams and C-suite stakeholders
  • Champion the broader Security team’s initiatives, not just Network Security Engineering
  • Participate in the maintenance and tuning of all network security technologies including WAFs, CDNs, VPNs, and application-aware firewalls
  • Leverage and contribute to automation pipelines for global firewall rule deployment and policy management across the network estate
  • Utilize security tooling telemetry and data collection automations to produce actionable reporting and metrics for internal teams and executive stakeholders

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of hands-on network security engineering experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale security solutions
  • Expert-level proficiency in Palo AltoNetworks — NGFWs, Panorama policy management, and PAN-OS; PCNSE or PCNSC certification strongly preferred
  • Expert troubleshooting skills across network and application layers, including packet capture analysis on complex, dynamically routed architectures
  • Deep understanding of layer 7 web application technologies and WAF/CDN platforms (e.g. Akamai, Cloudflare, Imperva, F5) — onboarding, policy tuning, break/fix troubleshooting, and operational management
  • Solid grounding in API security — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, evaluating identified vulnerabilities, and partnering with application teams to drive remediation
  • Strong HTTP/application security knowledge: TLS interception, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, command injection, LFI/RFI, rate limiting, bot detection, geo-blocking, and sinkholing
  • Intermediate to advanced network routing and switching knowledge with focus on DNS, TCP/IP, IPsec, TLS, GRE, OSPF, and BGP
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python preferred) and familiarity with Linux/CLI tooling
  • Working knowledge of public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Experience with at least one SIEM platform for log analysis, behavioral analytics, and rule tuning
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven track record of taking ownership in unstructured environments — cutting through ambiguity, making sound decisions with incomplete information, building stakeholder consensus, and delivering security improvements without waiting for top-down direction

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Industry certifications: PCNSE, PCNSC, CCNP/CCIE Security, GIAC (GWAPT, GPEN, or similar)
  • Experience building metrics pipelines and KPI reporting for security operations
  • Familiarity with interconnecting disparate security technologies to solve unique application and security challenges

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

154,000.00 – 161,000.00 USD per year

Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on, highly technical role responsible for securing JLL’s global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings a security-first mindset, a bias towards action, and deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies alongside broad command of API security, WAF/CDN platforms, and complex troubleshooting across network and application layers. You’ll work collaboratively with global engineering, application, and security teams to ensure security controls are intelligence-driven, optimized, and aligned to industry best practices.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Palo Alto Networks technologies (NGFWs, Cloud NGFW, Panorama), Web Application Firewall, Content Delivery Network, API Security, IDS/IPS, and DDoS prevention
  • Own onboarding, policy tuning, and lifecycle management for WAF and CDN platforms; lead firewall ruleset optimization, IDS/IPS tuning, and DDoS protection configuration
  • Partner with internal teams to drive the global rollout, tuning, and operational management of URL filtering and TLS decryption across the network estate
  • Lead API security efforts — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, identifying vulnerabilities, and working with application teams on fixes
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex, multi-layer global network and application issues — from packet captures on inter-continental BGP topologies to WAF false-positive triage
  • Partner with business and application teams to produce clear, actionable security documentation, change proposals, and executive-ready findings
  • Analyze existing network security architectures, processes, and procedures to identify gaps and drive meaningful improvements
  • Configure and report on defensive measures against advanced threat actor tactics; maintain current awareness of the evolving threat landscape and the effectiveness of our defenses against them
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both global engineering teams and C-suite stakeholders
  • Champion the broader Security team’s initiatives, not just Network Security Engineering
  • Participate in the maintenance and tuning of all network security technologies including WAFs, CDNs, VPNs, and application-aware firewalls
  • Leverage and contribute to automation pipelines for global firewall rule deployment and policy management across the network estate
  • Utilize security tooling telemetry and data collection automations to produce actionable reporting and metrics for internal teams and executive stakeholders

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of hands-on network security engineering experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale security solutions
  • Expert-level proficiency in Palo AltoNetworks — NGFWs, Panorama policy management, and PAN-OS; PCNSE or PCNSC certification strongly preferred
  • Expert troubleshooting skills across network and application layers, including packet capture analysis on complex, dynamically routed architectures
  • Deep understanding of layer 7 web application technologies and WAF/CDN platforms (e.g. Akamai, Cloudflare, Imperva, F5) — onboarding, policy tuning, break/fix troubleshooting, and operational management
  • Solid grounding in API security — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, evaluating identified vulnerabilities, and partnering with application teams to drive remediation
  • Strong HTTP/application security knowledge: TLS interception, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, command injection, LFI/RFI, rate limiting, bot detection, geo-blocking, and sinkholing
  • Intermediate to advanced network routing and switching knowledge with focus on DNS, TCP/IP, IPsec, TLS, GRE, OSPF, and BGP
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python preferred) and familiarity with Linux/CLI tooling
  • Working knowledge of public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Experience with at least one SIEM platform for log analysis, behavioral analytics, and rule tuning
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven track record of taking ownership in unstructured environments — cutting through ambiguity, making sound decisions with incomplete information, building stakeholder consensus, and delivering security improvements without waiting for top-down direction

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Industry certifications: PCNSE, PCNSC, CCNP/CCIE Security, GIAC (GWAPT, GPEN, or similar)
  • Experience building metrics pipelines and KPI reporting for security operations
  • Familiarity with interconnecting disparate security technologies to solve unique application and security challenges

raw.description:
About us

At Longdue, we’re dedicated to crafting narrative-first, psychologically deep, RPGs.

We focus on creating games with real depth—whether in our characters, environments or the stories we tell. We’re here to challenge your choices, your morality—everything you think you know. We’re here to make games where decisions matter and have consequences. We want to build on the legacy of classic story-driven RPGs while reviving the genre meaningfully.

Our goal is simple: to become a trusted name in the greater RPG canon.

With talent from the original Disco Elysium team and veterans from the wider industry, including Bungie and Rockstar, we’re creating something new—a project that resonates, challenges, and leaves a lasting mark.

We’re Longdue, and we’re finally here.

The role

We are seeking a talented Writer to help craft an immersive, multi-layered RPG experience for our computer RPG in its early stages. The gameplay will focus on dialogue choices, character interactions, and a branching story where every decision has consequences. You’ll be responsible for creating narrative content that combines psychological depth, philosophical musings, and a richly evocative world that brings player choices to life.

Responsibilities

  • Write compelling dialogue and narrative events that deepen the connection between characters and the world.
  • Develop a rich story that explores the interplay between the physical environment and the protagonist’s mental journey.
  • Contribute to building a universe awash in contrasts, where environments from two interconnected worlds reflect each other in direct and mysterious ways.
  • Collaborate with designers, artists, programmers, and your colleagues in narrative to ensure the story is deeply integrated with gameplay, emphasising role-play and skill-based checks inspired by TTRPG mechanics.

Requirements

Must-have

  • Proven experience in writing for video games, especially RPGs or interactive fiction. Creative writing or screenwriting experience is also highly valued.
  • Ability to craft a story that explores themes of psychogeography, human psychology, and the dark corners of society. We want characters and dialogue that are multifaceted, flawed, and profoundly human.
  • Ability to develop environments that reflect the character’s internal state, exploring connections between space, mood, and psychology.
  • An interest in delving into cosmic mysteries, existential questions, and philosophical ideas about society, power, and individual purpose.
  • Capable of working within a creative team, taking feedback constructively, and contributing to the shared vision of the project.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with narrative-heavy RPGs.
  • Experience in crafting non-combat gameplay loops that revolve around storytelling, exploration, and character development.
  • Knowledge of TTRPG-inspired mechanics such as dialogue reels, dice-based checks, or psychological skill systems.
  • Experience writing in media other than video games.

Benefits

Creative freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-provoking project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

Join Us: We’re here to make narrative-first, psychologically deep RPGs. If you’re passionate about storytelling, design, and pushing the boundaries of what games can be, Longdue is the place for you.

Claims Senior Casualty Adjuster

Job Summary

The Claims Senior Casualty Adjuster handles moderate to high complexity claims involving material damage, property and/or liability lines of insurance written by the Interinsurance Exchange in compliance with all regulatory and statutory requirements. The primary functions include liability investigation, coverage evaluation, negotiation strategies and claims resolution of moderate to high complexity claims. Employs discretion and independent judgment to ensure compliance with state and federal law, and with established company, technical, and customer service best practices. Under general supervision, works within specific limits of authority to resolve claims.

Job Duties

  • Conduct phone and/or field investigations to determine liability and damages. May attend and participate in legal proceedings. Identify and obtain statements from insureds, claimants and witnesses.

  • Communicate and interact with a variety of individuals including insureds and claimants. Explain benefits, coverages, fault and claims process either verbally or in writing in compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements. Recognize and appropriately address moderate complexity coverage issues.

  • Evaluate and determine claim values upon receipt and assessment of property, bodily injury and liability data.

  • Negotiate within settlement authority with insureds and claimants to resolve first and third party claims.

  • Update database production reports, and document and update claim files via company systems, i.e. CACS, HUON, HOC, GUIDEWIRE, etc.

  • Control expenses for areas of responsibility.

  • Verify and interpret / resolve coverage by gathering necessary information to ensure policy applicability. Coordinate with internal and external departments as required.

  • Respond quickly to customer needs and problems.

  • Independently resolve claims within authority level.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors Equivalent combination of education and experience Preferred

  • 7-9 years Prior claims handling experience. Preferred

  • 4-6 years Property, Auto, Casualty or relevant claims administration experience. Required

  • Comprehensive knowledge of claims administration best practices and procedures.

  • Advanced knowledge of insurance, fault assessment, negligence and subrogation principles required.

  • Comprehensive understanding of building and vehicle repair procedures and third-party liability issues.

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office suite, general computer software and claims software.

  • Advanced organization and planning recognition skills required.

  • Advanced oral and written communication skills required.

  • Advanced interpersonal skills required.

  • Advanced leadership skills among peers required.

  • Exhibit proficiency and understanding of medical terminology and causality

  • Valid Driver's License, acceptable Department of Motor Vehicles record and minimum liability insurance - Issued by State Required

  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter - Insurance Institute of America Preferred

  • Associate in Claims - Insurance Institute of America Preferred

  • An insurance/claims adjuster license may be required for claims administration in specific states.

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel to business meetings or conferences.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Lead Technical Marketing Manager to shape how Lumen brings its cybersecurity capabilities to market. This role translates complex security technologies, architectures, and threat intelligence into credible technical narratives, demonstrable solutions, seller-ready guidance, and customer experiences that accelerate adoption and revenue.

As a senior individual contributor, you will consult on and lead initiatives in partnership with many functions—Product Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Partners, and our threat research team, Black Lotus Labs. You will own high-impact technical marketing programs across the cybersecurity portfolio and influence product and go-to-market decisions through customer insight, market evidence, technical depth, and commercial judgment.

Location and Schedule

This is a work-from-home position in the United States. Occasional travel is expected for customer engagements, industry events, demonstrations, sales enablement, and team planning sessions.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own the technical marketing strategy: Define and execute technical marketing priorities for Lumen cybersecurity solutions, connecting portfolio strategy to customer use cases, architectures, adoption motions, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Create differentiated technical positioning: Develop clear, defensible messaging and value propositions for technical buyers and practitioners, including CISOs, security architects, SOC leaders, network leaders, and cloud security teams.
  • Build solution narratives and architectures: Translate cybersecurity capabilities into end-to-end reference architectures, validated use cases, solution blueprints, integration patterns, and deployment guidance across network, cloud, edge, and security operations environments.
  • Demonstrate the technology: Design and deliver compelling product demonstrations, technical workshops, webinars, videos, labs, and proof-of-value experiences that show how Lumen and its partners solve priority customer problems.
  • Lead technical content development: Create and govern high-value assets such as white papers, technical briefs, solution guides, blogs, FAQs, architecture diagrams, competitive guides, and technical launch materials.
  • Enable sellers and technical teams: Develop role-based training, discovery guidance, objection handling, battlecards, demo scripts, technical FAQs, and field playbooks that improve seller confidence, solution quality, and conversion.
  • Launch and support growth motions: Serve as the technical marketing lead for attach, cross-sell, and expansion motions. Ensure product, marketing, sales, and partner readiness before market activation.
  • Bring market and customer insight into decisions: Use customer conversations, competitive intelligence, analyst research, win-loss findings, field feedback, and performance data to identify gaps and recommend changes to product strategy, positioning, packaging, and activation.
  • Advance partner-led solutions: Collaborate with strategic cybersecurity partners to create integrated technical narratives, validated architectures, joint demonstrations, content, enablement, and go-to-market programs.
  • Represent Lumen as a technical authority: Engage customers, analysts, partners, and industry audiences as a cybersecurity subject-matter expert while maintaining accurate, evidence-based, and brand-safe claims.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Lead complex workstreams without direct authority, establish clear outcomes and ownership, resolve dependencies, and create repeatable methods that improve the quality and speed of technical marketing execution.
  • Measure and optimize impact: Define success metrics and use adoption, pipeline, content, enablement, demonstration, and customer-feedback data to improve programs and prioritize investment.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, engineering, marketing, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree or relevant security certifications are a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in technical marketing, product marketing, product management, solutions engineering, technical pre-sales, cybersecurity consulting, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated cybersecurity depth across several domains such as network security, DDoS mitigation, SASE/SSE, firewalls, cloud security, threat intelligence, or security operations (SIEM/XDR/MDR).
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, cloud and hybrid architectures, security controls, telemetry, APIs, integrations, and operational workflows.
  • Proven ability to convert complex technical capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated positioning, credible proof points, and actionable field guidance.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, reference architectures, workshops, white papers, solution guides, or comparable practitioner-focused content.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from hands-on practitioners through executive audiences.
  • Ability to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives across multiple functions without direct authority, while maintaining clear decisions, accountability, and momentum.
  • Commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to connect technical marketing investments to adoption, pipeline, revenue, attach, retention, or expansion outcomes.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with multiple priorities, high visibility, and a strong expectation for quality and execution.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience marketing managed security, network-embedded security, threat intelligence, or integrated networking and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Experience working with global telecommunications, cloud, networking, or managed security providers and their technology ecosystems.
  • Hands-on familiarity with security platforms, product labs, demonstration environments, scripting, APIs, or data visualization.
  • Established credibility with customers, analysts, technical communities, or industry events through presentations, publications, workshops, or thought leadership.

Become a part of our caring community

The Genesys Cloud Access Management supports the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of the Genesys contact center platform in support of the Humana Military organization. This role contributes to the development and execution of contact center and customer experience strategies while ensuring seamless integration with existing IT and telecommunications infrastructure. Work assignments are varied and frequently require the interpretation of business and technical requirements, independent judgment, and the determination of appropriate solutions.

This Genesys Cloud Access Management position supports Humana Military's customer engagement and contact center technologies by administering, securing, and optimizing the Genesys Cloud platform with a primary focus on access management, user lifecycle administration, and platform governance. The associate is responsible for provisioning and deprovisioning user accounts, managing roles, permissions, groups, queues, and authentication controls, and ensuring compliance with organizational security and regulatory requirements.
