raw.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Director, GTM Data Analytics to lead and scale the analytics capabilities that drive go-to-market performance and revenue growth. This strategic leadership role will define the vision, strategy, and operating model for GTM analytics, transforming complex data into actionable insights that inform executive decision-making, improve forecasting, and increase sales productivity.

The Senior Director will establish a trusted, integrated analytics framework across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance, ensuring leaders have consistent visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, rep-level performance, and key revenue drivers. This leader will oversee the development of scalable data products, KPI governance, automated reporting, and predictive analytics capabilities, including AI-enabled insights that improve business outcomes.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an analytics executive who can combine strategic vision, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build a world-class GTM analytics function. The successful candidate will partner closely with executive leadership to translate business priorities into analytical strategies that accelerate decision-making, improve accountability, and support Kaseya’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Data & Analytics Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year GTM analytics strategy aligned with business priorities and revenue objectives. Establish the operating model, delivery standards, and roadmap for analytical products, ensuring investments are prioritized based on business impact and measurable outcomes.
  • Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Own executive-level GTM performance reporting, scorecards, and analytics used to evaluate pipeline health, bookings, revenue, sales productivity, retention, and expansion. Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for executive leadership and board discussions.
  • KPI Development & Data Governance: Establish and maintain consistent, trusted definitions for GTM metrics, including pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycles, quota attainment, and rep productivity. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance to align metric definitions, ownership, data quality, and reporting standards.
  • Forecasting & Predictive Analytics: Lead the development and continuous improvement of pipeline, bookings, and revenue forecasting capabilities. Leverage historical trends, leading indicators, and predictive modeling to improve forecast accuracy, identify performance risks, and inform territory planning, capacity decisions, quotas, and resource allocation.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Sales Operations to integrate CRM, marketing automation, customer success, product usage, billing, and financial data into a unified GTM analytics ecosystem. Drive automation of recurring reporting and develop scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical products using shared enterprise platforms.
  • AI-Enabled Insights & Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and predictive analytics to GTM performance, including opportunity scoring, churn and expansion risk, forecast automation, and automated insight generation.
  • Executive Partnership & Business Adoption: Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior GTM and functional leaders. Collaborate with stakeholders to define business questions, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and ensure analytical insights translate into decisions and measurable action. Drive adoption through effective communication, training, documentation, and integration into business operating routines.
  • Organizational Leadership & Development: Build and lead a scalable, multi-layer analytics organization, including managers and senior individual contributors. Establish organizational structures, career paths, and operating practices that support growth while developing future leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact.
  • Budget & Resource Management: Own the GTM analytics budget, evaluate investments in talent and technology, and develop business cases that demonstrate the value of analytics initiatives. Prioritize resources and tooling to maximize efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.
  • Continuous Improvement & Scalability: Establish standards for analytical solution development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Reduce manual reporting efforts, improve data reliability, and build reusable analytics capabilities that scale with business growth.
  • Cross-Functional Data Strategy: Partner with enterprise data and technology teams to influence platform priorities, integration strategies, and vendor decisions affecting GTM analytics. Support the integration of data and reporting from acquired businesses into Kaseya’s GTM analytics environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, reporting, or forecasting, including leadership of analytics functions supporting go-to-market organizations within SaaS or technology businesses.
  • Deep expertise in GTM and revenue analytics, including pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance, rep-level productivity, and revenue-driving metrics.
  • 5+ years of experience leading analytics or business intelligence teams, including managing managers and leading multiple teams or functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing an analytics strategy and building, scaling, or transforming an analytics organization.
  • Proven experience owning executive-level GTM reporting, KPI frameworks, forecasting, and decision-support capabilities within a complex organization.
  • Experience managing an analytics budget, evaluating technology investments, and prioritizing resources based on business impact.
  • Strong technical proficiency with Salesforce, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and modern business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Experience integrating multiple data sources, developing scalable reporting solutions, and implementing data governance practices that improve data quality, consistency, and automation.
  • Experience applying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled capabilities to business data to improve forecasting, performance insights, or decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite executives and senior business leaders, communicate complex analytical findings clearly, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong organizational leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, IT management, cybersecurity, or a related technology environment.
  • Experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools, semantic modeling, and enterprise BI governance.
  • Background in revenue analytics, Sales Operations, territory and capacity planning, or enterprise performance management.
  • Experience deploying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled solutions in production environments, including opportunity scoring, churn prediction, or forecast automation.
  • Experience integrating data, systems, and reporting capabilities following acquisitions, particularly within private-equity-backed or high-growth organizations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple regions.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable analytics capabilities that improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, and revenue performance.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

😎 Our Culture
Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.
As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.
We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.
At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.

In this role, you will guide the technical strategy for enterprise deals, aligning Quantum Metric’s platform with strategic business initiatives. You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.

We are actively hiring across multiple levels within our Solutions Engineering organization (from core Solutions Engineers to Staff-level talent).     • Preferred Qualifications

As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. Providing a simplified approach to monitor, diagnose and optimize the digital journeys that matter most, the Quantum Metric platform offers in-depth customer understanding, quantified and tied to core business objectives.

We work as one team to provide trust, the right expertise and support from start to finish and ultimately have fun and celebrate success along the way.

What’s In it for You?

The Opportunity:

  • To promote and sell a wealth of innovative Sika technologies nationally within the industrial manufacturing market sectors.
  • The role will require both new and existing sales, with proactive sales within new areas being a key part of the growth and success of the business

The Rewards:

You will be rewarded with a competitive salary and a sweep of great benefits. We pride ourselves on our total reward package:

  • Bonus Scheme
  • Holiday 25 days rising to 28 days with service, plus bank holidays

The opportunity to progress within a global company across a variety of business areas.

raw.excerpt: Who We Are:Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital's measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup.

You'll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones.
  • Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts.
  • Build and automate a data quality process. Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out.
  • Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query.
  • Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts.
  • Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client's own layer.
  • Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex's AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them.

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size.
  • Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code.
  • Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control.
  • Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases.
  • Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic.
  • An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results.
  • Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer.
  • Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust.
  • Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users.

Helpful but not required

  • Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift).
  • Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data.
  • Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools.
  • Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role
  • Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources.
  • Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source.
  • Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages.
  • Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps.
  • Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround
  • AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup.
  • Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout.
  • Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
    • Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

At Wedgewood Pharmacy, we are dedicated to improving the lives of animals through customized medication and compassionate care. Every role in our organization contributes to helping pets live healthier, happier lives. We are a team driven by purpose, quality, and a shared commitment to animal health.

Wedgewood is seeking a full time Inside Sales Representative. The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is responsible for generating sales, market share and profitability for Wedgewood — both compounding and Blue Rabbit — within a specific Book of Business. This may include general-practice accounts or specialty/strategic hospital accounts.

Location / Schedule:

Remote; candidates must be able to attend occasional in-person meetings as needed. Monday–Friday, either 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. ET or 10:30 a.m.–7:00 p.m. ET.

What you’ll do:

Sales Execution & Performance

  • Implement and execute effective sales strategies to place Wedgewood’s compounding products and Blue Rabbit’s technology in clinics within the Book of Business, growing sales and customer base.
  • Develop an in-depth knowledge base of assigned clinics — products stocked, business objectives, decision-making process, key staff and technology footprint.
  • Use effective selling and account management skills to move customers to Wedgewood/Blue Rabbit.
  • Maintain the daily dial activity and account-level Reach, Frequency and Qualified Contact standards defined in the Inside Sales Representative Role, Performance & Activity Standards policy.

Business Management

  • Create a business plan for the Book of Business identifying the best strategic path to gain sales growth across compounding and Blue Rabbit.
  • Execute the business plan and complete objectives, including achieving sales targets while operating within a specified expense budget.
  • Use CRM and sales tools to create pre-call plans, maintain customer engagement information and retain clinic records.

Product Knowledge

  • Maintain and utilize Wedgewood and competitive product and technical knowledge.
  • Execute Wedgewood and Blue Rabbit brand and portfolio strategies to drive sales.
  • Use designated marketing and sales tools to ensure consistent sales and marketing messaging.

Opportunity Management

  • Analyze available data — sales, market share and competitive intelligence — to identify the best growth opportunities.
  • Prioritize clinics to pursue the highest-growth opportunities and gain product placements.
  • Maintain an accurate, documented pipeline of opportunities within the business plan.

Competitive, Market & Industry Knowledge

  • Develop market, customer and industry knowledge.
  • Monitor market conditions for changes that impact Wedgewood’s business.
  • Continuously gather knowledge of competitors and how to position Wedgewood’s solutions against them.

Who you are

  • Aptitude and desire to sell and gain market share; comfortable with a high-volume, daily outbound calling cadence.

  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, negotiation and presentation skills (verbal and written).

  • Strong learning agility.

 

What you’ve done:

  • High School Diploma required. Associate's or Bachelor’s Degree preferred

  • 1-2 years of lead generation/sales experience; inside sales experience preferred

  • Demonstrated experience in relationship development, opportunity identification and pipeline tracking and building.

  • Experience in relationship development, opportunity identification and pipeline tracking.

  • Knowledge of animal health/veterinary clinic industry experience preferred

 

What’s in it for you:

  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and flexible spending accounts

  • 401(k) retirement plan with a generous company contribution to help you save for the future

  • Company Paid Life and disability insurances

  • Access to voluntary insurance options (including pet insurance!)

  • A generous paid time off program that increases every year

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Opportunity for growth - We believe in promoting from within and do so through our internal job posting program!

  • Compensation Range: The base pay range for this position is $60,000-$80,000 annually + a quarterly bonus incentive (commensurate with the individual's experience and qualifications).

#lp

Why We Do What We Do

At Wedgewood Pharmacy, your work has purpose. Every prescription you help prepare, support, or deliver contributes to improving the health and well-being of animals. We are passionate about what we do and proud to build a workplace where people feel supported, included, and valued.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Wedgewood Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

Overview

JOB TITLE: Systems Security Engineer

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: Department of Defense (DoD), Federal Voting Assistance Program (FVAP)

POSITION INFORMATION: Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting federal agency clients

LOCATION: Fully Remote (U.S.)

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

CLEARANCE: Must be able to obtain and maintain an FVAP Public Trust and FVAP badge.

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking a Systems Security Engineer to support the Federal Voting Assistance Program (FVAP) through the hardening, patching, and compliance of Linux, Windows, and database systems hosted in an AWS environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience implementing DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and Security Requirements Guides (SRGs), maintaining system security posture, and supporting federal cybersecurity compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • System Hardening & STIG Compliance
    • Implement and validate DISA STIGs across Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Windows Server, and other platforms.
    • Harden MySQL databases against the MySQL STIG and the Application Security and Development SRG.
  • Patch & Vulnerability Management
    • Plan, deploy, and verify patches for Windows and Linux systems.
    • Identify and remediate vulnerabilities in support of ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Cloud Security
    • Support secure configuration of AWS resources, including VPCs, security groups, and Systems Manager.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • 5+ years of professional related experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field, required.
  • STIG implementation experience across Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Windows Server, and other platforms.
  • Experience patching Windows and Linux systems, including deployment and verification.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, including VPCs, security groups, and Systems Manager.
  • Strong cybersecurity fundamentals, including security hardening and compliance concepts (STIGs, SRGs, vulnerabilities, etc.).
  • Database security experience, including MySQL hardening against the MySQL STIG and the Application Security and Development SRG.

PREFERRED:

  • Vulnerability scanning experience using ACAS/Nessus.
  • Compliance experience, including Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) management and support of cyber task orders.

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to the nature of this government contract.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This is a fully remote position within the U.S. No relocation or office reporting is expected.

ITC Federal is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

raw.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity and privacy expertise, solutions, and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach to evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources, and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

We are looking for a motivated and engaging Principal Consultant, Data Governance, to join our growing team. This is a fully remote, individual contributor role with occasional travel to support client consulting engagements. The focus of this role is to deliver GuidePoint’s Data Security Governance and AI Governance services, helping organizations develop their data security and AI governance strategy and build the programs that operationalize it, in alignment with industry leading practices. The successful candidate is a hard-working, self-motivated professional who mentors and shares learnings with colleagues to foster a learning culture.

About the Governance Practice

GuidePoint's Governance and Risk Practice delivers advisory, assessment, strategy, and program development services that help organizations build governance frameworks balancing security requirements with business innovation. While this role focuses on our data-related services, the practice spans a broader portfolio including cyber maturity and risk.

Our consultants and analysts partner with clients across industries to build sustainable governance and risk programs, including:

  • Data security and AI governance (primary focus): Maturity and readiness assessment, strategy, and program development across data security governance (DSMM), AI governance (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF), and privacy (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, NIST-P, AICPA PMF)
  • Cyber maturity: NIST CSF-based maturity assessments, advisory, and program development and remediation
  • Cyber risk: Qualitative and quantitative risk assessments, third-party risk, and ongoing risk management services

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Deliver successful Data Security Governance and AI Governance engagements, from maturity and readiness assessments through strategy and program build, while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Help clients develop data security and AI governance strategy and build the supporting program, including target-state roadmaps, operating models, roles, and lifecycle governance, assessed against the DSMM, ISO 42001, and the NIST AI RMF.
  • Develop and present strategic roadmaps, program recommendations, and senior-level summaries to executive and board-level stakeholders.
  • Advise clients how data security and AI governance tooling technologies map to their data governance, data security governance, and AI governance objectives, including but not limited to Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), data classification and discovery, encryption/tokenization, and data governance/cataloging platforms.
  • Assist with sales by supporting SOWs, proposals, pricing, and RFP responses, and by routing cross-sell opportunities (for example, data security tooling) to adjacent GuidePoint teams.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and mentor, sharing knowledge and developing the skills of colleagues to foster a learning culture across the Governance team.
  • Stay current on evolving data security and AI governance regulations, standards, and best practices, and advise clients on the implications for their programs.
  • Represent GuidePoint as a thought leader in data security and AI governance and contribute to the growth and maturation of the consulting practice.
  • Build strong customer relationships and work with other GuidePoint practices as part of a cohesive cross-functional team.

Required Experience and Education:

  • Minimum of 7+ years in cybersecurity or data governance roles, including 5+ in a client-facing consultant role.
  • Strong understanding of data security governance concepts, controls, and frameworks, including data discovery, classification, and data-centric protection and monitoring.
  • Demonstrated experience building or assessing AI governance programs, with working knowledge of ISO 42001, the NIST AI RMF, and the EU AI Act.
  • Proven ability to translate assessment findings into strategy, operating models, roadmaps, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Strong familiarity with modern AI/ML and automation tooling and concepts (for example, LLMs and Python).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to convey complex concepts to technical and executive audiences and prepare clear, actionable deliverables.
  • Collaborative team player with a growth mindset, able to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to simplify complex issues and provide pragmatic advice and practical solutions that can be operationalized.
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Expertise in data privacy is an optional and nice-to-have skill, including familiarity with frameworks such as NIST Privacy, ISO 27701, AICPA PMF, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA and the ability to deliver privacy gap and program assessments.
  • Strong preference for candidates who can deliver data security governance and AI governance assessment and strategy engagements and extend across the broader data governance portfolio.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CDPSE, AIGP, CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPT, or CIPM.
  • Thought leadership through white papers, webinars, published content, and conference speaking on data security governance, AI governance, and other GRC trends.

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 25% travel

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans
  • 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program
  • Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance
  • Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment
  • Pet Benefit Option

raw.description:
Description

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

The Program Manager, Engineering Services is the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients and owns their success end to end: delivery quality, client satisfaction and commercial growth. You will lead multidisciplinary teams delivering utility design and subsurface engineering scopes, keep contracts on schedule and on margin, and turn strong delivery into follow-on work.

This is a true seller-doer role that sits between delivery and growth. You run the work, you own the relationship, and you help win what comes next.

What You'll Do

Own the client relationship

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients, from contract award through closeout and renewal.
  • Own client satisfaction: set expectations, report status, resolve issues quickly and escalate early on scope, schedule or budget risk.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across owner and prime-consultant organizations, from project engineers to program directors.
  • Lead regular project and business reviews covering performance, outcomes and value delivered.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on engineering design processes, adoption of AI technologies, and management of project risk.

Deliver engineering-services contracts

  • Take overall accountability for the quality of engineering-services deliverables, including utility design, conflict analysis and subsurface utility engineering scopes.
  • Establish the work plan, fee estimate, schedule and staffing for each phase, and lead the kickoff with client stakeholders.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams of engineers, designers, and data specialists to produce on-time, on-budget deliverables.
  • Confirm deliverables meet client, agency and industry standards at conceptual and final design levels.
  • Drive the QA/QC plan, assign qualified technical reviewers and ensure sealed or certified deliverables meet professional standards.
  • Manage subconsultants and teaming partners against scope, schedule, quality and contract requirements.

Control scope, schedule and margin

  • Own project budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs; track hours, expenses and earned value.
  • Maintain the project management plan, risk register, decision log and change documentation.
  • Identify scope changes early and manage change requests and contract amendments with the client.
  • Lead recovery planning on troubled projects and run lessons-learned at closeout.

Win future work with key clients

  • Join pursuit teams for future work with key clients, contributing to go/no-go decisions, win strategy, pricing and risk reviews.
  • Lead or support technical approach, staffing and scope sections of proposals, and present in interviews.
  • Track upcoming client programs, solicitations and contract vehicles (IDIQ, on-call, task-order and design-build teaming).

Grow key accounts

  • Own commercial growth of assigned key accounts, with targets for retention, expansion and follow-on contract value.
  • Build and execute account plans aligned to each client's capital program, project pipeline and digital-delivery goals.
  • Identify expansion opportunities: new task orders, additional programs and divisions, and cross-sell of Exodigo mapping and digital-twin services.
  • Partner with Sales on handoffs into long-term account ownership and on new opportunities you surface.
  • Keep CRM records current for account health, pipeline and forecast.

Lead and collaborate

  • Mentor and develop project staff; provide performance input to their managers.
  • Work with Engineering, Operations, Product and Sales to deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Feed client insight back into Exodigo's service offerings, AI-assisted design tools and product roadmap.
  • Represent Exodigo at client meetings, industry events and professional organizations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil, Electrical or a related engineering discipline.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in at least one US state, with the ability to obtain comity licenses as needed.
  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years managing design or engineering-services contracts for clients.
  • Public-sector client experience (state DOTs, transit agencies, airports, public utilities or municipalities) is required.
  • Proven record of growing and retaining large, complex client accounts, with follow-on work you helped win.
  • Working knowledge of utility design and coordination, and of subsurface utility engineering.
  • Strong command of project controls: work plans, fee estimates, budgets, schedules, earned value, change management and risk registers.
  • Experience preparing proposals and presenting in client interviews.
  • Understanding of public-sector procurement and contract types, including QBS, IDIQ / on-call, task-order and design-build delivery.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication with technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% and work effectively in a remote, high-growth environment.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Engineering.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), DBIA or CCM certification.
  • Experience in transportation, rail, aviation, power or water infrastructure programs.
  • Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build or alliance delivery, including bridging documents.
  • Experience working for or teaming with large AEC/EPC firms as prime or subconsultant.
  • Familiarity with geophysical methods (GPR, EM, magnetics) and ASCE 75 utility as-built data standards.
  • Proficiency with design and BIM tools (MicroStation/OpenRoads, Civil 3D, Revit) and digital-delivery workflows.
  • Interest in applying AI-assisted design to engineering production.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations (ASCE, ACEC, ARTBA, APTA, ACI-NA or similar).

Key strengths

  • Ownership: you take full accountability for delivery quality and account outcomes.
  • Trusted advisor: clients call you first when a project gets hard.
  • Commercial instinct: you see the next contract inside the current one.
  • Builder: you thrive where processes are still being written.

Compensation - We offer a highly competitive, above-market total compensation package

  • Base: $156,000 - $192,000
  • OTE: $260,000 - $320,000

Location: Miami, FL or Seattle, WA (or easily accessible to)

raw.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business. We have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines.

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video.

About The Team And Position

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

We expect bright people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, step in wherever needed, mentor and develop team members, and assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions.

Position Overview:

This position is responsible for creating, auditing, and processing customer paperwork to timely and accurately register a vehicle. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Participate in the development of strategic plans, goals, and objectives, ensuring alignment with those of Market Operations and company.
  • Work with senior management to define documentation accuracy goals and objectives.
  • Manage and appraise the accuracy and completeness of all customer paperwork within the hub, determining and directing corrective action as needed.
  • Define and implement paperwork best practices to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory standards.
  • Continuously evaluate team effectiveness and hub level success in fields of paperwork accuracy and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Provide guidance and performance feedback to Paperwork Specialists, Customer Advocates, and market leadership to ensure effective paperwork procedures are in place.
  • Assess any process gaps and problem solve solutions efficiently, utilizing expertise and leveraging cross-functional teams.
  • Assist with customers as needed via phone, email, and text to obtain information necessary to accurately complete customer paperwork and vehicle titling and registration.
  • Partner with the Regulatory Compliance team to create and maintain compliance best practices within your hub. Track regulatory compliance success to determine and implement training requirements.
  • Work closely with local regulatory agencies and/or partners to receive, generate, and submit paperwork in compliance with local requirements.
  • Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

What the Job Requires

  • Bachelor degree or 5+ years experience with document processing including medical billing, paralegal or similar experience required.
  • Ability to lead a team successfully, maintaining a culture of accountability and growth.
  • Ability to coach to performance with both direct reports and peers.
  • Ability to get and maintain Notary in your local jurisdiction within the first 90 days of employment.
  • Ability to manage, organize, and reconcile multiple sources of information with accuracy.
  • Ability to diagnose, prioritize, and solve problems with varying complexity while maintaining a focus on team engagement and customer relations.
  • Ability to communicate with customers, external partners, managers, direct reports, and coworkers effectively in a professional, courteous manner.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
  • Ability to work independently with little to no supervision to accomplish goals, meet deadlines, and find solutions.
  • Computer literacy and data entry accuracy.
  • Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary, including weekends.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must have a clean driving record with no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years.

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Hourly Position.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Franchise Brand Marketing Manager – Kitchen, Bath & Closet Remodeling

Role Details
Reports to: VP of Marketing
Location: On-site (Huntersville, NC) or remote
Employment type: Full-time, exempt
Travel: Up to 30%, for location visits, grand openings and brand events.

About Us
Based in Huntersville, NC, Homefront Brands is an established platform for franchised property services businesses in North America. We have 6 brands (and growing) operating on our platform. Our mission is to be the growth engine for aspiring entrepreneurs, established business builders and our veterans to create and enhance the American dream of building a better future, through the application of our world class franchise models.

About the Opportunity

The Brand Marketing Manager supports the VP of Marketing as the marketing point of contact for The Designery franchise locations and leads implementation of the overall marketing strategy. The role focuses on social media, content, reputation management, grand openings and grassroots community marketing.

The Designery is a HomeFront Brands franchise offering custom kitchen, bath and closet design from local showrooms. As the system grows, this role helps give franchise owners clear direction from day one, consistent local content and reviews, and launches that turn into design consultations.


Additional resources include: HomeFront Brands CMO and marketing team, franchise owners and their staff, Operations, Franchise Development and onboarding.

Key Responsibilities

Social media and content
  • Own social media strategy, content development and audience growth on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook for brand and franchise locations.
  • Build a steady content pipeline with locations: before-and-after project photos, video and reels, and showroom and designer features, with credit standards when imagery is shared across the brand.
  • Measure and report social and content performance monthly.
Reputation management
  • Manage reviews and online reputation across Google, Facebook and other platforms: response standards, review generation and escalation.
  • Report review volume, ratings and response times by location monthly.
Franchise support and strategy implementation
  • Support the VP of Marketing as the marketing point of contact for franchise locations, from signing through opening and ongoing operations.
  • Implement the overall marketing strategy across locations, helping each franchise owner build an annual local marketing plan, backing lead goals out of their revenue target and close rate and aligning spend to brand guidance.
  • Run regular marketing reviews with owners: lead volume and source, cost per lead, consultations booked, and where to shift budget.
  • Coach owners on local SEO, Google Business Profile, paid search and social, email, referral and B2B (designer, builder, realtor) programs, and community marketing.
  • Keep Google Business Profile setup, categories and listings consistent across all locations.
  • Create templated, easy-to-adopt toolkits: campaign kits, social and content guidelines, before-and-after project content standards, email templates, and event formats such as Lunch and Learns.
  • Host recurring franchisee marketing trainings and workshops, and stay current on kitchen and bath marketing tactics and trends so the team is seen as the expert resource.
  • Act as the franchisee's voice inside the brand team, surfacing feedback to improve tools, vendors and processes.
Grand opening playbook
  • Own and continuously improve The Designery's turnkey grand opening playbook: a repeatable process for the marketing team and clear for franchise owners.
  • Lead each new location through pre-opening, grand opening and first-90-days marketing: signage and showroom readiness, local launch campaigns, event registration and RSVP tracking, PR and community outreach, and post-event follow-up that converts guests to design consultations.
  • Coordinate timelines with Franchise Development, onboarding and Operations so every new owner knows what is needed, by when, from the first day.
  • Measure every launch (registrations, attendance, leads, consultations, first-year revenue) and feed lessons back into the playbook.
Grassroots and community marketing
  • Develop grassroots programs locations can run: designer, builder and realtor events, Lunch and Learns, home shows, sponsorships and community partnerships.
  • Provide event kits and track the leads and consultations each program produces.
Vendor and agency management
  • Manage the brand's marketing vendors and agencies, including the local marketing platform (social, reviews, listings), signage and print, direct mail, digital and paid media partners, and PR support.
  • Hold vendors to their contracts and statements of work: service levels, turnaround times, revision limits and reporting.
  • Onboard franchisees to approved vendors with clear instructions so owners are never left to navigate agencies alone.
  • Evaluate vendor performance and cost and recommend changes or new partners as the system grows.
PR support and brand communications
  • Assist with national and local PR as needed, in partnership with the VP of Marketing, including agency coordination, media requests and story ideas from locations.
  • Support each location's local PR: launch announcements, ribbon cuttings, community partnerships and project features.
  • Help run brand-level influencer and creator partnerships that showcase high-end projects in priority markets.
  • Protect brand standards in all franchise and consumer-facing marketing while leaving room for authentic local content.
Other duties as assigned
  • Support brand initiatives such as the annual franchise conference, website and content updates, and brand fund reporting.
  • Perform other duties assigned by the VP of Marketing.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 2 years supporting franchise owners or multi-location businesses.
  • Hands-on experience in social media, content and reputation management, plus grand opening, event and grassroots marketing.
  • Proven experience managing agencies and vendors against contracts and budgets.
  • Working knowledge of local digital marketing: Google Business Profile, local SEO, paid search and social, email, and review management.
  • Experience supporting PR efforts, such as media outreach and agency coordination.
  • Comfortable reading lead and campaign data and turning it into clear recommendations for small-business owners.
  • Excellent communicator who builds trust quickly and can coach, and push back, with confidence.
  • Highly organized; able to manage many locations and projects at once.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Willing to travel for location visits, grand openings and brand events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Home services, home improvement, remodeling, kitchen and bath, cabinetry or interior design experience.
  • Experience with high-consideration, consultative purchases and premium or luxury audiences.
  • Experience with influencer or creator programs and B2B trade referral marketing.
  • Familiarity with the tools we use, such as Searchlight and ServiceMinder, plus local marketing platforms, CRM and email tools (such as HubSpot), event registration tools, and project management tools (such as Monday.com).

What success looks like

First 90 days
  • Met with each franchise owner alongside the VP of Marketing and documented each location's marketing plan, vendors and gaps.
  • Audited the current grand opening process and shipped version 1 of the playbook for the next openings.
  • Reviewed every marketing vendor's contract and SOW and set a regular performance review with each.
  • Standardized Google Business Profile setup across locations.
First year
  • Every location has a written local marketing plan with lead goals tied to revenue.
  • Each new location launches on the playbook, with registrations, attendance and consultations tracked end to end.
  • Franchise owners rate marketing support higher in satisfaction surveys than the prior year.
  • Monthly social, content and reputation reporting in place, with followers, engagement and review ratings trending up.
  • Vendor turnaround and revision issues reduced, with documented SLAs.


HomeFront Brands is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace.

This is a builder role: you will have real ownership and a direct impact on how Cycode goes to market through partners.

raw.description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the development and delivery of next-generation mission computing systems for military aircraft platforms. You will lead cross-disciplinary engineering teams through the full system life-cycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, technical integrity, and stakeholder alignment. Your structured approach, calm leadership under pressure, and commitment to ownership will be key to delivering high-performance, safety-critical systems in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the integrity and suitability of the design of next generation mission computing products and for leading the life-cycle management of the product, including design reviews, verification, and qualification activities.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the full systems engineering life-cycle from stakeholder needs analysis through to delivery, verification, and certification.
  • Coordinate cross-functional engineering teams across software, hardware and safety domains.
  • Manage requirements using DOORS, ensuring traceability, audit readiness, and V&V evidence.
  • Conduct risk management reviews and change control governance for engineering activities.
  • Utilise Model Based Systems Engineering to create a robust model of the system being developed
  • Follow Systems Engineering processes to develop technical solutions to engineering problems
  • Collaborate with the system, hardware and software architects to ensure consistency, design for modularity and re-use, and technical excellence
  • Involvement in the full life-cycle from requirements analysis to delivery

Successful candidates should ideally possess:

  • Degree level education or equivalent in a relevant engineering discipline
  • Extensive experience across the full Systems Engineering lifecycle
  • Proven leadership skills in coordinating multidisciplinary teams
  • Expertise in requirements management, traceability, and audit-ready documentation
  • Proficiency with DOORS and Excel-based planning tools
  • Understanding of certification processes and regulatory standards
  • Experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
  • Strong knowledge of Avionic System engineering challenges
  • Demonstrated high levels of motivation, integrity, and professionalism
  • Flexibility, innovation, and commitment to delivery in fast-paced environments
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models is preferred

This role has a salary of between £45,600 - £60,000 plus our flexible benefits package.

This role can be offered on a fully remote basis, although we would encourage and welcome on-site presence whenever practical.

We pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose, offering impressive benefits:

  • A compressed nine-day fortnight and compressed hours - which means every other Friday off.
  • A personalized career development plan, alongside regular progress reviews - supporting and valuing your progression within the Company.
  • A flexible working environment where your contributions are recognized and rewarded with flexible benefits

We believe in maintaining a diverse workplace - inclusive of beliefs, cultural background, job experiences, thoughts and ideas. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we welcome you to join our inclusive team!

Our success is fuelled by our colleagues and the wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills they bring to the Company.

We are a Disability Confident Employer, as such we offer an interview to disabled people who meet the minimum criteria for the job.
Please email if you would like your application to be considered under the DC Scheme.

All successful/appointed applicants must be able to obtain a level of UK Security clearance that is appropriate for the role and undertake suitable Right to work checks.

Every application matters to us. We want you to know that each application we receive is reviewed by a real person—not just an algorithm. Our screening questions are also carefully considered to help us understand your experience and fit for the role.

We appreciate the time you take to apply.

General Dynamics Mission Systems engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of more than 13,000 top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defence and scientific arenas. In the UK, we are leading the way in avionics and communication systems. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency.

General Dynamics in St Leonards-on-Sea currently provide avionic mission computing systems for a wide range of military fast jets, helicopters, and UAV’s. Recent success has resulted in General Dynamics developing the next generation of Advanced High Performance, Safety Critical Mission Computer Systems to meet the needs of latest platforms in development by several aircraft manufacturers. These Mission Computing Systems provide the functionality that integrates aircraft systems, sensor systems and stores management systems with the information and control systems required by the aircrew to meet the demanding operational needs of these aircraft.

raw.description:
AECOM is seeking a highly motivated Civil Underground Utility Design Engineer to support the planning, design, coordination, and implementation of underground utility infrastructure projects. This role is primarily a civil engineering position focused on underground pathway design, utility corridors, duct banks, utility crossings, and associated civil infrastructure.

The successful candidate will have practical experience developing buildable underground utility designs for electric, water, wastewater, telecommunications, or other buried infrastructure systems. Telecommunications experience is helpful but not required. The strongest fit is a civil design professional with hands-on experience creating underground pathway layouts, reviewing plan-and-profile drawings, coordinating utility conflicts, and supporting permitting and construction delivery.

This is a fully remote position requiring collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams, utility owners, permitting agencies, municipalities, transportation agencies, and construction personnel across multiple geographic regions.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Underground Utility Infrastructure Design

  • Develop and review civil engineering designs for underground utility systems and utility corridor projects. Design underground pathways, duct banks, trenches, utility crossings, access structures, conduit systems, and related civil infrastructure.
  • Evaluate utility routes and develop buildable alignments for greenfield and brownfield projects.
  • Incorporate utility conflicts, right-of-way constraints, environmental considerations, agency requirements, and permitting conditions into design solutions.
  • Prepare construction drawings, plan-and-profile sheets, details, specifications, exhibits, and permit packages.
  • Support utility relocation planning, pathway optimization, and coordination between proposed and existing infrastructure.

Civil 3D Design and Engineering

  • Modeling Use Autodesk Civil 3D to develop and review alignments, profiles, surfaces, corridors, grading, utility layouts, and civil design models.
  • Generate and validate plan-and-profile drawings, utility exhibits, quantity takeoffs, design calculations, and project deliverables.
  • Analyze conflicts between proposed underground utility pathways and existing subsurface or above-ground infrastructure.
  • Integrate survey data, GIS information, LiDAR, utility records, as-builts, and field information into engineering models.
  • Support digital engineering workflows and model-based delivery practices.

Engineering Review and Quality Assurance

  • Perform technical reviews of civil utility design packages and engineering deliverables.
  • Verify compliance with client standards, utility owner requirements, agency criteria, and industry best practices.
  • Review depth of cover, utility separations, crossings, access spacing, corridor configurations, constructability, and maintainability.
  • Identify design risks, utility conflicts, constructability issues, and deficiencies, and provide clear recommendations for resolution.
  • Support quality management reviews and continuous improvement of design delivery standards.

Utility Coordination and Permitting

  • Coordinate with utility owners, municipalities, transportation agencies, permitting authorities, and project stakeholders.
  • Support utility conflict resolution, utility relocation planning, and agency coordination throughout design and construction.
  • Assist with permit applications, design exhibits, agency comments, and regulatory review responses. Participate in design review meetings, utility coordination meetings, and constructability workshops.

Construction and Implementation

  • Support Provide engineering support during construction and implementation activities.
  • Review contractor RFIs, submittals, field modifications, and change requests.
  • Evaluate field conditions and recommend practical civil engineering solutions.
  • Support as-built documentation, redline review, and project closeout activities.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline plus 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Experience with Autodesk Civil 3D is required.
  • Experience developing civil engineering plans or underground utility designs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.
  • Experience designing underground utility pathways, utility corridors, duct banks, utility crossings, utility relocations, or buried infrastructure systems.
  • Background in civil infrastructure, electric distribution, water/wastewater utilities, municipal utilities, transportation utilities, telecommunications, or other utility design environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of Autodesk Civil 3D, AutoCAD, ArcGIS, Bluebeam Revu, Bentley OpenRoads, or similar engineering platforms.
  • Experience interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, survey data, utility records, and construction documents.
  • Working knowledge of utility coordination, right-of-way requirements, permitting processes, and agency review procedures.
  • Experience performing utility conflict analysis, subsurface utility coordination, constructability reviews, quantity takeoffs, and cost estimating.
  • Familiarity with DOT requirements, utility accommodation policies, municipal design standards, and common underground utility design practices.
  • Experience supporting transportation, municipal, utility, industrial, energy, data center, broadband, or large infrastructure projects.
  • Telecommunications or fiber optic OSP design experience.
  • Sponsorship is not available for this role now or in the future.
  • Relocation is not available for this role.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees.
