Description

Java Developer – Data Adapters (AML Platform)

Position Overview

Matrix is seeking experienced Java Developers to design, develop, and support data adapters that integrate banking source systems with an enterprise anti-money-laundering (AML) platform powered by NICE Actimize.

Data adapters are responsible for extracting data from upstream banking systems, validating and transforming it into the required target format, and loading it into the AML platform. These feeds include transactions, trades, accounts, customer and party information, and reference data. The accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of this data are critical to effective AML transaction monitoring, alert generation, and case management.

The ideal candidates will have strong backend Java development experience, hands-on expertise in ETL or data integration, and the ability to manage data adapters throughout the development lifecycle—from source-to-target mapping and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain Java-based data adapters to ingest data from batch files, database extracts, message queues, and REST APIs.
  • Analyze source-system specifications and translate source-to-target mapping requirements into reliable transformation, enrichment, and validation logic.
  • Integrate data from banking systems into the AML platform, ensuring alignment with the platform's data model and interface requirements.
  • Implement data-quality and reconciliation controls, including schema validation, null checks, duplicate detection, record counts, control totals, and source-to-target reconciliation.
  • Develop robust error-handling and recovery mechanisms, including reject and error queues, restart and reprocessing capabilities, idempotent processing, logging, and alerting.
  • Optimize adapter performance to process high-volume data efficiently and meet defined batch windows and service-level agreements.
  • Apply bulk loading, partitioning, parallel processing, and SQL optimization techniques to improve throughput and processing efficiency.
  • Develop and execute unit and integration tests, and support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production deployments.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement fixes across source, adapter, and target systems.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, Actimize implementation teams, and client source-system teams to onboard new data feeds and manage upstream changes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, source-to-target mappings, data lineage, and operational runbooks to support auditability and ongoing maintenance.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow established coding, security, testing, and release-management standards.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Java: 5+ years of backend Java development experience, with strong knowledge of Core Java, including collections, concurrency, streams, I/O, and exception handling. Java 11 or 17 preferred; Java 8 or later required.
  • Data Integration: At least 2 years of hands-on experience developing and supporting production ETL, data ingestion, or data integration solutions.
  • Frameworks: Strong experience with Spring and Spring Boot; hands-on experience with Spring Batch or an equivalent batch-processing framework.
  • SQL and Databases: Strong SQL skills with Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including complex queries, stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, JDBC, and bulk-loading techniques.
  • Data Formats and Integration: Experience working with delimited and fixed-width files, XML, JSON, SFTP, REST APIs, and messaging technologies such as Kafka or IBM MQ.
  • Data Mapping: Ability to interpret source specifications and target schemas and develop accurate, documented source-to-target mappings.
  • High-Volume Processing: Experience processing large datasets, including millions of records per execution, within defined batch-processing windows.
  • Testing: Hands-on experience with JUnit, Mockito, and integration testing using representative datasets.
  • Development Tools: Working knowledge of Unix/Linux, shell scripting, Git, Maven or Gradle, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
  • Scheduling: Experience with enterprise job schedulers such as Control-M or AutoSys.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work directly with client stakeholders in an onshore/offshore delivery model.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or supporting data integrations for NICE Actimize modules, including AIS, UDM, ActOne, AML-SAM, or CDD.
  • Exposure to other AML, financial-crime compliance, or transaction-monitoring platforms.
  • Banking or capital markets domain experience, particularly with trades, payments, wire transfers, accounts, customer data, and KYC attributes.
  • Understanding of AML transaction monitoring, alert generation, and case investigation processes.
  • Familiarity with big-data and streaming technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka Streams, or Hadoop.
  • Exposure to cloud data services on Microsoft Azure or AWS.
  • Experience with data lineage, data-quality frameworks, and regulatory audit requirements.
  • Previous experience working in regulated financial-services environments with formal change-management processes and controlled development, testing, and production environments.

WHY JOIN US

﻿Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast‑growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

To learn more, visit: www.matrix-ifs.com

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: Matrix is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind. Matrix is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Matrix are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in our locations. Matrix will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Matrix encourages applicants of all ages.

raw.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff’s E-commerce team builds an app-to-web product that drives mobile app users to purchase on Shopify web stores. We operate like a startup inside Liftoff. Requirements shift as we learn from live customers, and most problems arrive without an internal playbook. We built the product from the ground up and have already shipped major performance wins.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll turn ambiguous problems into sound designs and execution plans, then drive them to production. You’ll own architecture and technical decisions for core targeting and attribution systems, and help shape the team’s work through design and code review. When customer performance drops, you’ll trace the cause through our systems, determine whether it’s a bug or a market signal, and turn the finding into a design.

Responsibilities:

  • Own epics end to end, including scoping, design, delivery, and production health.
  • Help set the team’s technical direction and long-term roadmap.
  • Build privacy-compliant data systems that expand reach while maintaining accuracy.
  • Design attribution logic that captures more of the purchases we drive without overcounting.
  • Lead customer performance deep dives and turn findings into experiments.
  • Research new tools and approaches, and recommend solutions that balance short-term and long-term needs.
  • Review design docs and PRs, and help set the team’s bar for reliability, scalability, observability, privacy, cost efficiency, and documentation.
  • Partner with ML engineers to improve conversion models, including training data and conversion signal quality.
  • Build and extend our Shopify app and web pixel.
  • Mentor engineers and help hold the senior engineering bar in interviews.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Minimum Bachelors Degree and 8 yrs of relevant experience. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in place of a formal degree.
  • Experience leading the design and delivery of complex projects across multiple engineers.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus fluent SQL (Trino, Spark, or equivalent).
  • A track record of taking ambiguous problems from scoping to shipped outcome with minimal oversight.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose performance or data discrepancies across a multi-stage pipeline, from raw signal to reported outcome.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and event-driven systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent).
  • You operate with Agency and Urgency by taking initiative to solve problems and drive outcomes independently, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • You have a Growth Mindset and are adaptable, quick to test, iterate, and improve both ideas and your own skill set.
  • Experience with identity resolution, probabilistic matching, or device graphs is a plus.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with web attribution or conversion tracking, such as pixels, server-side conversion APIs, or attribution platforms.
  • Working knowledge of browser privacy constraints and data privacy regulations.
  • Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

Working at Liftoff is fast-paced, fun, and challenging, and we thrive on innovation. Come join our team and help shape the future of the mobile app ecosystem. If this role sounds interesting to you, we would love to hear from you!

Location:This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:
Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

The following are our base salary ranges for this role:

  • SF Bay Area, NYC, Los Angeles/Orange County: $210,000 - $260,000
  • Seattle/Olympia, Austin, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Boston: $193,000 - $239,000
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $180,000 - $223,000

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. Product Launch & Commercial Readiness Leadership

raw.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PCMag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated, cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PCMag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated, cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions. We support physicians through continuous enhancements to our products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

Job Purpose and Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI/Data Architect to design and manage the data infrastructure that supports reporting, advanced analytics, and AI applications across WRS Health. This role will work closely with AI Engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to make healthcare data accessible, reliable, secure, and ready for use in machine learning and large language model (LLM) applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain scalable data architectures and pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications.

  • Define data models, storage strategies, and integration patterns for structured and unstructured healthcare data.

  • Build and maintain pipelines to collect, clean, transform, and validate data from clinical, financial, operational, and marketing systems.

  • Partner with AI Engineers to define data requirements and prepare datasets for model development, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

  • Design the data foundation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, vector storage, and retrieval.

  • Establish shared data interfaces and APIs that enable AI Engineers to integrate LLM capabilities into EHR applications.

  • Manage data storage and retrieval for patient records, IoT, genomic, microbiome, and government datasets.

  • Support healthcare interoperability using FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, C-CDA, NCPDP, and X12 standards.

  • Design and manage AWS data and analytics infrastructure supporting QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Develop reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights across departments.

  • Establish data quality checks, lineage, versioning, and documentation so datasets and AI outputs can be traced to their sources.

  • Implement access controls and appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare data across analytics and AI workflows.

  • Collaborate with AI Engineers on MLOps and LLMOps requirements, including reproducible data pipelines, monitoring, and deployment integration.

  • Monitor and improve infrastructure reliability, retrieval performance, processing speed, and operating costs.

  • Translate stakeholder needs into technical specifications and maintain architecture documentation.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in data architecture and engineering, including infrastructure supporting AI or machine learning applications.

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, and scalable data processing.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines and API integrations.

  • Experience designing solutions using relational databases, data warehouses or data lakes, and vector databases.

  • Hands-on experience with data preparation for LLM applications, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation.

  • Understanding of how data quality, retrieval design, and source context affect LLM response accuracy and relevance.

  • Experience with AWS data and AI services, including familiarity with QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including dataset versioning, evaluation datasets, and production monitoring.

  • Working knowledge of LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex to collaborate effectively with AI Engineers.

  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and access controls for sensitive healthcare information.

  • Experience with FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, X12, and healthcare data exchange is highly preferred.

  • Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Healthcare industry experience and familiarity with HubSpot are a plus.

A Day in the Life

You’ll review pipeline health and data quality, collaborate with AI Engineers to prepare datasets and improve data retrieval, and build data models, integrations, and dashboards. Throughout the day, you’ll work with stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure the infrastructure supports reporting and AI application needs.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline reliability, data freshness, and data quality meet agreed targets.

  • AI Engineers receive validated, traceable datasets within agreed timelines.

  • Retrieval accuracy, response times, and infrastructure costs meet project targets.

  • Reporting and data automation reduce manual work and support stakeholder adoption.

If you are passionate about building the data foundation for practical healthcare AI solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Hours: Available during standard U.S. Eastern business hours (9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. or 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.)
Location: Remote | Full-time

This job description outlines the general requirements of the position and is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Other duties may be assigned as necessary to support departmental operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
About Us

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what’s going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We’re a technology-led service with a human touch.

About the Role

Scorpion is hiring a Product Marketing Manager to drive revenue growth and product adoption by supporting go-to-market execution. Working across product, marketing, and sales, this role helps turn product value into compelling positioning, content, and enablement that support commercial success. You'll help ensure Scorpion's products reach the right clients with the right message, contributing to product performance, cross-functional alignment, and overall company impact.

You're right for this role if you're a clear, curious communicator who enjoys turning complex product details into messaging people understand and connect with. You like being close to both the product and the field, talking to sales, digging into data, understanding how to tell a good story, and building the content that supports a deal. You're organized, collaborative, and eager to grow your craft alongside more senior product marketers. You are curious, you understand how to use data to simplify a story and create a differentiated message, and you have a proven track record of driving revenue growth for a business.

You should be deeply committed about understanding our clients' pain points and how they actually use our products, and you'll treat client and prospect interviews as a core, recurring part of the job, not an occasional check-in.

What Your Success Will Look Like

  • Support Go-to-Market Execution: Support execution of go-to-market plans by coordinating timelines, assets, and cross-functional check-ins to help ensure on-time, high-quality delivery.
  • Contribute to Messaging & Positioning: Help develop differentiated messaging and positioning based on client research, product insights, and competitive analysis.
  • Build Full-Funnel Content: Develop content and messaging across the full customer journey to support awareness, adoption, and retention. This team should deliver an ongoing and consistent drumbeat externally that showcases our products, our customers benefiting from our products, and their value to the market.
  • Assist with Win/Loss Analysis: Participate in win and loss analysis and help document insights for product, campaign, and market teams.
  • Support Client & Prospect Research: Support ongoing client and prospect interviews to understand pain points, adoption and engagement opportunities, and feed those insights directly into positioning and messaging.
  • Partner with Client Experience: Work with the Client Experience team to surface client sentiment, usage trends, and recurring pain points that should inform messaging and go-to-market strategy and support sales enablement materials.
  • Build Trust with Product Management: Build strong, trusted relationships with Product Management, partnering closely to translate product direction and client needs into go-to-market plans.
  • Support alignment of Messaging with Sales: Work closely with Sales to understand which messages are resonating in the field and which aren't, using that feedback to continuously sharpen positioning.
  • Support Account Management on Upsell and Feedback: Partner with Account Management to understand how messaging can support upsell and expansion motions, and to capture ongoing feedback from existing clients.

Who You Are And What You Bring

  • Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience
    • 2-4 years of experience in product marketing or B2B marketing, with hands-on exposure to go-to-market execution and messaging.
    • Content Creation: Experience creating content and assets that support awareness, adoption, and retention across the customer journey.
    • Project Management: Experience managing multiple campaigns, launches, or enablement projects simultaneously, with accountability for timelines and quality.
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with sales, demand generation, and product teams to align on messaging and campaign needs.
    • Nice to Have:
      • Relevant Background: Background in B2B digital marketing services, SaaS, or Martech.
      • SMB Familiarity: Familiarity with SMB or local-business buyer journeys.
  • Skills
    • Messaging & Positioning: Ability to develop and refine messaging and positioning based on research, product input, and competitive context.
    • Emerging Trends & Tools: Curiosity and willingness to explore emerging GTM tools and formats, including AI-driven content, and proactively share ideas with the team.
    • Analytical Skills: Proficiency with tools such as Salesforce, Seismic, ClickUp, and basic reporting dashboards to track content and campaign performance.
    • B2B Marketing Knowledge: Understanding of B2B buying cycles and how product marketing supports pipeline and revenue goals.
    • Communication Skills: Ability to translate product details and campaign results into clear, actionable content for sales and marketing partners.
    • Initiative & Independence: Ability to manage assigned responsibilities independently, take initiative, and proactively communicate when additional support is needed.
    • Nice to Have:
      • Content Skills: Copywriting or content creation experience.
      • Data Skills: Comfort working with data in Excel, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Travel: Minimal - occasional travel for team off-sites or company events, as needed.

Our Scorpion Values

  • Winning Mindset: When our clients win, we win.
  • Genuine Care: We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.
  • Unmatched Results: We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.
  • Constant Improvement: We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask “What if?” we build and then do it again.
  • Unbeatable Teamwork: We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

Compensation

We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.

  • The base salary range is $120,000 (entry-level) - $150,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.
  • The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

Our Benefits

We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits
  • Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid cell phone and service
  • Remote office allowance
  • Professional development and development courses
  • Regular manager check-ins to drive performance and career growth through Lattice

Work Location & Flexibility

Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. Specific expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Scorpion is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or physical or mental disability. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion.

This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

raw.description:
About Raenest

Raenest is a global financial platform helping individuals and businesses connect to the global economy.

From receiving international payments and spending globally to sending money across borders, investing, and growing their money, Raenest gives people more ways to participate in the global economy.

We're growing our presence in Brazil and looking for someone who can help us reach more people, build meaningful partnerships, and drive adoption.

About the Role

We're looking for an ambitious, resourceful, and well-connected Growth & Partnerships Executive to help accelerate Raenest's growth in Brazil.

We want someone who understands the local market, knows how to find opportunities, build relationships, acquire customers, and turn ideas into results.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be connecting with people, building communities, exploring partnerships, executing campaigns, and helping more Brazilians discover what they can do with Raenest.

You'll work closely with our central growth team to identify opportunities and drive measurable results.

Primary duties and responsibilities

  • Drive customer acquisition: Find creative, cost-effective ways to attract individuals and businesses looking to receive, spend, send, invest, and grow their money globally.
  • Build strategic partnerships: Identify and establish relationships with businesses, communities, creators, organisations, and platforms that can drive adoption across the region.
  • Expand our reach: Identify new customer segments, distribution channels, and growth opportunities in Brazil.
  • Execute local campaigns: Support grassroots marketing, referral programmes, events, community activations, and other growth initiatives.
  • Drive product adoption: Help customers discover and use Raenest's available products, including global accounts, international transfers, cards, and other financial solutions.
  • Activate and retain customers: Turn signups into active, transacting customers and encourage repeat usage.
  • Build local relationships: Connect with influencers, community leaders, business networks, and potential distribution partners across target markets.
  • Understand the market: Gather customer insights, monitor competitors, and identify local payment behaviours, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Own your numbers: Track customer acquisition, activation, partnership performance, transaction growth, and other key metrics.
  • Support market expansion: Help identify local opportunities, market requirements, and potential partners as Raenest expands across Brazil.

Job Requirements

    • 2+ years of experience in growth, partnerships, business development, marketing, or sales.
    • Strong understanding of the Brazilian consumer and business landscape.
    • A natural networker who knows how to connect with people and build relationships.
    • Creative, resourceful, persistent, and comfortable working with limited resources.
    • Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese, with good written and spoken English.
    • Comfortable executing independently and taking ownership of results.
    • Strong commercial instincts and an ability to identify opportunities.
    • Familiarity with Brazil's digital payments ecosystem, including Pix, local banking, cross-border transactions, and consumer behaviour.
    • Experience in fintech, payments, technology, telecommunications, e-commerce, or consumer products is an advantage.

We're not looking for someone with the fanciest CV. We're looking for someone who knows how to make things happen.

What Success Looks Like

  • Growth in verified and actively transacting customers.
  • Increased adoption of Raenest's products across different customer segments.
  • Partnerships that generate measurable customer acquisition and transaction activity.
  • Stronger brand awareness and community presence in Brazil.
  • Consistent growth in transaction volume and repeat usage.
  • New, scalable customer acquisition opportunities.

Why Join Raenest?

You'll help more Brazilians access opportunities beyond borders while building the presence of a fast-growing global financial platform.

You'll have the freedom to experiment, build relationships, test ideas, and see the direct impact of your work.

We value initiative, creativity, speed, and people who get things done.

Who We Are:

Ordergroove is building the future of Relationship Commerce by providing an innovative, customizable, and reliable subscriptions and incentives platform. We’re looking for bright, talented people who are excited about innovation, customer experience, and the rapidly changing world of Relationship Commerce.

About the Role:

Product Marketing at Ordergroove sits at the intersection of market insight and product momentum. You'll develop a sharp understanding of our products, our customers and the industry then use that intelligence to shape product stories, enablement playbooks, and competitive positioning that drive new bookings and merchant growth.

This is a deeply cross-functional role, partnering across Product and Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and beyond. You'll work across the full product lifecycle, from discovery through Early Access and GA to post-launch adoption.

We're looking for product marketers who are creative, analytical, and detail-oriented, with strong communication, cross functional alignment, AI knowledge, and project management chops. You'll be one of two PMMs, which means high ownership and scope with significant impact.

What You Will Do:

  • Bring a storyteller's instinct to everything you touch, flexing your communication to land with any audience, from an enterprise buying committee and CDO to an ecomm manager, and distilling complex products into value propositions people actually remember.
  • Own the voice of the customer, win/loss analysis, ICP, and market signals, and bring ARR-weighted customer and competitive insight into each roadmap planning cycle. You hunt for non-obvious insights and pair them with genuine passion for users, producing balanced, thoughtful points of view on how to take products to market.
  • Own the GTM Launch Brief and launch tiering for every release. Partner with PMs from Idea through GA on naming, differentiation requirements, and adoption needs, and sign off at each stage gate before a feature moves forward.
  • Use AI tools (from Claude to Lovable, plus our Product Hub MCP) to build analyses, designs, and frameworks that scale the PMM team beyond its headcount. You don't just use AI to polish drafts; you automate the tedious parts of the job (first-draft roadmaps, briefs, competitive scans) so your time goes to quality and taste.
  • Maintain the PMM operating system: product storytelling themes, buyer personas, and messaging matrix (quarterly), competitive intelligence (one deep competitor review per quarter), the roadmap narrative, and our Summer and Winter Groove releases.
  • Run monthly Sales and CS enablement, and own the quarterly sales deck, battlecards, and talk tracks so AEs, Partner teams and CSMs can sell without PMM in the room. This role is deeply collaborative and async-first; sometimes you're driving the bus, sometimes you're along for the ride, either way you work well across disciplines to get things shipped.
  • After launch, turn usage data into proof points and expansion messaging ("customers using X see Y"), refresh enablement based on real-world objections, and source customer stories from merchants who've genuinely adopted. You're confident in front of merchants and become the go-to expert in your domain.
  • Own merchant-facing product naming and keep it consistent across product, sales, and web. You thrive in fast-moving environments, moving fluidly between 30,000-foot strategy and the micro-details that make or break execution.
  • Support pricing and packaging research in partnership with Revenue and Product.

About You

  • 5-7 years of total relevant work experience that can span marketing, product marketing, growth marketing, product management, operational roles, or strategy consulting.
  • At least 3 years of specific product marketing or go-to-market experience.
  • Experience in Enterprise B2B or B2B2C SaaS and ecommerce or ecommerce adjacent is required. Experience in retail tech or fintech is preferred.
  • Technical understanding of AI agents, APIs, integrations, and data analytics, with the curiosity to go deep on agentic products like our Payment Agent, Retention Agent, MCP, and Workflows.
  • Comfortable in an async, write-it-down culture where Product Hub is the source of truth and docs, Looms, and recorded sessions replace status meetings.
  • Driven, passionate and persistent about getting your products to win in market.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work in a very fast-paced organization.

About Ordergroove:

Ordergroove powers recurring revenue for the world's largest and most innovative retailers including Ulta, Dollar Shave Club, La Colombe Coffee, Bonafide Health, BarkBox and more. As a direct result, more than 11% of adult Americans have a subscription powered by Ordergroove. Our technology makes seamless, one-of-a-kind subscriber and membership experiences possible to turn one-time transactions into profitable recurring customer relationships.

Ordergroove’s powerful platform empowers merchants with highly customizable options such as flexible promotions, bundling, and analytics to bolster their bottom line while making customers' lives easier. We recently achieved a milestone year with 152% year over year new business growth, and were rated best-in-class subscription technology by CB Insights and eCommerce Platform of the Year by RetailTech Breakthrough Awards.

Our company values celebrate collaboration, different perspectives, and curiosity with the goal of getting to the right answer, no matter who came up with it. At Ordergroove we are committed to creating a welcoming and supportive environment for all people. We encourage people with different backgrounds and experiences to join our growing team so that we gain different perspectives and build the best team possible. We demand the best of ourselves and each other and never miss an opportunity to celebrate our successes.

With a fully flexible work from anywhere culture, staying connected and supporting each other are always top of mind. We build our tight-knit community through small group events like trivia night, cooking classes, and book clubs. We encourage cross-functional relationships through virtual coffees and we stay close to the business through weekly team updates and quarterly all-hands meetings.

At Ordergroove, we focus on flexibility and empowering our team to make the right decisions for themselves. We have flexible PTO and a totally remote (anywhere in the US) workforce, and an annual personal development budget that you use for what matters to you (wellness, career development, productivity at home, etc). And of course, that is on top of the basics like competitive compensation (including stock options) and incredible, affordable benefits. Come join our amazing team while we enable the fastest-growing segment of commerce that makes life easier for millions of consumers every day!

At Ordergroove, we want to hire, develop and retain the best talent, making Ordergroove a top destination to grow your career.

The pay transparency law is a way of narrowing the gender pay gap and fostering an engaged and positive working environment. It is also a way to share what we think is a reasonable, equitable and competitive compensation structure for the roles on our team.

Compensation: Starting at $137,000, plus stock options and competitive benefits.

We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join a Simplified Chinese voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 20 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).
  • Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.
  • Speak using your natural dialect and accent.
  • Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.
  • Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.
  • Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Simplified Chinese.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. At Curai, we believe that access to high-quality healthcare is a fundamental human right, not a privilege. Our mission is to radically transform healthcare by harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and clinical expertise to make care more affordable, accessible, and effective for everyone.

Lead Product Managers at Curai are force multipliers who tackle our most consequential product problems, shape product direction, and elevate the organization around them.

As Lead Product Manager, Activation, you'll own the first-use product experience, from the user's first message through clinical handoff, across direct-to-consumer and partner channels. You'll identify and remove barriers to conversion, improve how users discover and engage with non-clinical services, and shape new opportunities to help people get the care and support they need.

Who you are

  • A systems thinker who connects consumer behavior, acquisition, clinical delivery, technology, and business performance, anticipating consequences across boundaries.
  • A strategic product thinker who identifies high-impact growth opportunities, reframes difficult problems, and develops a point of view that changes product direction.
  • An expert in consumer activation, with a deep understanding of acquisition funnels, activation, conversion, retention, and experimentation.
  • A hands-on contributor who creates clarity in ambiguity, challenges weak assumptions, and builds alignment without avoiding difficult disagreements.
  • A rigorous quantitative thinker who interrogates data, distinguishes evidence from conjecture, and uses it to challenge assumptions and make better decisions.
  • A precise written and verbal communicator who makes complex decisions, reasoning, and requirements clear
  • A thoughtful builder with exacting standards, who cares as much about the quality of the experience as the outcomes it drives.
  • A relentlessly curious builder who seeks out new ideas, challenges their own thinking, and continually raises the quality of their work and the work of those around them.

What you’ll do

    IMPACT
  • Own and continuously improve the first-use product journey, from the user's first interaction through clinical handoff, increasing conversion rates for all DTC and partner funnels.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on acquisition landing pages and the transition into the product experience, ensuring acquisition strategy and first-use conversion are informed by shared evidence and performance data.
  • Lead consequential, cross-functional initiatives that deliver sustained improvements in conversion and business performance.
  • Shape first-use experiences that establish the foundations for long-term engagement, identifying and improving early behaviors that predict retention and continued product use.
  • Develop an evidence-grounded direction for your product area, identifying which opportunities warrant investment and which to exclude.
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities to extend the first-use experience into valuable non-clinical services, such as appointment booking, cost estimation, and healthcare administration.
  • Shape first-use journeys for retail, health plan, and health system partners, balancing channel-specific requirements with a scalable, coherent product experience.

    • CRAFT

  • Develop product frameworks, requirements, and approaches that bring clarity to complex, interconnected problems and enable multiple teams to execute independently.
  • Make dependencies, assumptions, and decisions explicit, enabling coordinated execution and adapting plans within shared priorities and commitments.
  • Design and evaluate growth experiments with clear hypotheses, appropriate measurement, and an understanding of statistical and practical significance.
  • Independently analyze product data, including funnels, cohorts, channel performance, and experiments, to diagnose conversion barriers, evaluate competing hypotheses, and substantiate product and investment decisions.
  • Define AI product behavior, evaluation criteria, and safe clinician handoffs with Design, Engineering, AI, and Clinical partners.
  • Define how product capabilities, workflows, and data fit together, identifying structural gaps and shaping scalable solutions.
  • Partner with Clinical Product leadership to ensure effective transitions into clinical workflows and longitudinal care, respecting clinical eligibility, safety, and operational constraints.
  • Identify and escalate systemic obstacles to quality and velocity, making it easier for teams to deliver excellent work independently.
  • Combine consumer insight, behavioral evidence, and technical understanding to shape product choices and resolve uncertainty.

    • TEAM

  • Raise the quality of product thinking, quantitative reasoning, and execution beyond personal initiatives through exemplary work and critique.
  • Partner with Product leadership to increase quality and velocity.
  • Develop peers’ judgment and independence through coaching and mentorship.

What you’ll need

  • 8+ years of demonstrable experience leading consumer product growth, with sustained, measurable improvements in activation, conversion, or other consequential growth outcomes.
  • Deep practical experience with product analytics, funnel optimization, cohort analysis, and experimentation, including independently conducting analyses and translating findings into product decisions.
  • Strong analytical and written judgment, demonstrated through artifacts that drove investment and execution.
  • Experience building products that use AI or LLMs, with an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and evaluation approaches.
  • Sustained evidence of driving meaningful user outcomes and strategic influence beyond your directly owned work.
  • Examples of reframing consequential problems, resolving uncertainty across boundaries, and enabling others to deliver more effectively.
  • Experience aligning marketing, technical, operational, and business partners around difficult trade-offs.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry is preferred.

Culture: A mission-driven team of talented colleagues who are committed to living our values, collaborating closely, and driving meaningful impact in healthcare.

  • Flexible spending plans
  • Responsible Vacation Policy

In keeping with our beliefs and values, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital or domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. raw.title: Senior Modeling & Simulation Engineer: Power Systems
raw.excerpt: OverviewThe technology that powers Mainspring’s linear generator is unlike any other generator technology on the market.
raw.description:
Overview

    The technology that powers Mainspring’s linear generator is unlike any other generator technology on the market. The linear generator relies on innovative power electronics and control systems to achieve its best-in-class efficiency while meeting the world’s strictest emissions requirements. Our generators are being deployed in both front-of-the-meter and behind-the-meter applications, as blackstart-capable backup power and prime-power applications, and in microgrids, datacenters, and utility installations. Before a single unit is energized, our customers and suppliers need to know exactly how it will behave on their electrical systems.

    We have a high impact opportunity for a Modeling and Simulation Engineer to own the electromagnetic transient (EMT) models that Mainspring delivers to customers and suppliers. On the system modeling and simulation team, you will turn our product specifications and control system behavior into professional, versioned, customer-facing simulation models: an executable version of what Mainspring commits to. This role requires a quantitative understanding of power systems combined with a passion and aptitude for software, and the ability to bridge controls, electrical engineering, and product teams.
    Your success in this role will be instrumental in helping customers confidently integrate Mainspring linear generators into their electrical systems, shortening the path from proposal to interconnection to deployment. As the steward of how our generator appears to the outside world, you will collaborate across technical domains, frequently working with leaders in controls, electrical engineering, product development, and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the EMT models (e.g. PSCAD) of Mainspring linear generators that we deliver to customers and suppliers. These models cover DC power generation, startup, load steps and sheds, voltage and frequency disturbance, and IEEE 1547/2800 or NERC PRC-029 ride through scenarios
  • Identify the salient electrical behavior of the generator and its control system, and capture it in reduced-order and behavioral models that integrate with supplier inverter models and customer interconnection studies
  • Partner with product management and leadership to make sure every delivered model faithfully represents the contractual specified generator capabilities and maintain requirements for the simulation system based on input from customers and product management
  • Work with suppliers, such as inverter manufacturers, to integrate their models with ours, and support customers in grid integration and system studies
  • Manage models as a software product: maintain the git repository, version each release, write release notes and user documentation, and package deliverables professionally for external audiences
  • Generate test plans to validate model behavior against measured data from Mainspring linear generators. Oversee the execution of those plans with support from the test team
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers and suppliers using Mainspring models. Troubleshoot integration issues and feed what you learn back into the models
  • Contribute power systems expertise to the team's model-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments and to system simulations
  • Participate in peer review of code written in support of modeling, control, and software work throughout the team.
  • Generate written documentation (presentations, reports, etc.) of model design and simulation results for audiences both inside and outside Mainspring

Qualifications

  • Engineering degree (Electrical preferred, or another discipline with a strong electrical background) with a strong foundation in applied mathematics
  • Strong technical and analytical skills, with 5+ years of practical experience in power systems or power electronics: grid integration, inverter-based resources, electrical machines, DC systems, etc.
  • Familiarity with numerical techniques for simulating electrical systems and their use within commercial packages (e.g. PSCAD, EMTP, PowerFactory, Simulink/Simscape Electrical, PLECS, etc.)
  • Experience designing, building, and validating dynamic system models in a simulation environment or high-level programming language
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical behavior to external audiences
  • A power systems or power electronics background is the key filter. DevOps skills can be learned on the job. Previous PSCAD experience is a very strong nice to have, and should be achievable

Why Upbound?

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

Supports the execution of core electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) management activities across assigned clinical
projects, ensuring alignment with sponsor requirements, regulatory standards, and industry best practices. Provides eCOA-
specific support to study teams within Data Sciences, working under the direction of the eCOA Manager. Collaborates cross-
functionally to maintain system integrity, support study timelines, and contribute to the successful delivery of project
milestones. Supports departmental initiatives and company-wide strategic objectives through continuous process
improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Study Documentation: Prepare and draft eCOA documentation from templates (user guides, test scripts), revise based on feedback, and maintain approved documents in the eTMF

  • Testing and Validation: Perform basic testing of eCOA databases, support User Acceptance Testing with cross-functional teams, and document results while reporting issues for resolution

  • Study Deliverables: Support translation activities including screenshot reports, track translation and data transfer timelines, and generate and review report outputs for accuracy

  • Study Team Support: Perform administrative tasks, schedule meetings, provide user support by answering eCOA questions, and troubleshoot issues with escalation to the eCOA Manager when needed

  • Department Support: Contribute to continuous improvement through knowledge sharing and training, advocate for eCOA best practices, and participate in cross-functional working groups

  • Training Compliance: Complete all required training on time and maintain a minimum of 90% training compliance at all times

Skills & Qualifications

  • A minimum of a post-secondary certificate/diploma (college, Training Institute, etc.) + 1-3 years related experience.
  • Basic understanding of clinical trial processes, eCOA solutions, PRO questionnaires, and data collection within eCOA systems.
  • Familiarity with GxP, ICH Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP), and regulatory requirements for eCOA in multi-region clinical trials.
  • Working knowledge of study start-up procedures, questionnaire translation, screenshot review workflows, device/licensing logistics, and report/data transfer tracking.
  • Foundational experience with eCOA systems including routine data entry, running standard reports, system updates, and documentation (user requirements, UAT scripts, validation records).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with cross-functional teams (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, sponsors) and vendors across different time zones.
  • Ability to track timelines and issues on assigned studies effectively

What We Offer

    In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

    To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

    Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
    Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to .
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you.

Our energy expertise in the oil and gas sector comprises the entire value chain - upstream, midstream, and downstream; and in the power sector includes thermal, nuclear, waterpower, renewable, hybrid, transmission and distribution, and grid modernization. Join our vision of a low-carbon world and help make positive change!

We are seeking an experienced Lead Pipeline Engineer to provide technical leadership and engineering expertise across the development, design, assessment and execution of onshore and offshore pipeline projects. The role will support projects across the hydrocarbons spectrum with responsibility for delivering fit-for-purpose pipeline solutions from concept selection through FEED, detailed design, construction support and commissioning.

The successful candidate will act as a technical leader, providing engineering assurance, mentoring junior engineers, supporting client engagement activities and contributing to the continued growth of our pipeline engineering capability.

Key Responsibilities:-

Technical Delivery

• Lead and execute onshore pipeline engineering studies and design activities across concept, FEED, detailed design and execution phases.
• Perform pipeline routing, hydraulic analysis, wall thickness design, stress analysis and mechanical design assessments.
• Develop pipeline alignment sheets, design basis memoranda, technical specifications and engineering deliverables.
• Undertake constructability, operability and maintainability assessments.
• Support pipeline crossing design, buried pipeline assessments and geotechnical interface management.
• Perform pipeline integrity, fitness-for-service and remaining life assessments.
• Evaluate pipeline modification, debottlenecking and repurposing opportunities, including hydrogen and CO₂ service applications.
• Support risk assessments, HAZID, HAZOP and design reviews.

Technical Leadership

• Provide technical governance, quality assurance and independent review of engineering deliverables.
• Act as a technical authority and trusted advisor to project managers and clients.
• Mentor and develop pipeline engineers and designers.
• Drive continuous improvement of engineering methodologies, standards and best practices.
• Participate in proposal development, client presentations and business development activities.

Project Delivery

• Coordinate multi-disciplinary engineering teams and interface with civil, mechanical, process, geotechnical and construction disciplines.
• Support project planning, budgeting, scheduling and resource forecasting.
• Provide engineering support during procurement, construction, commissioning and start-up phases.
• Interface with clients, operators, regulators, contractors and third-party stakeholders.

Qualifications and Experience

Required Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical, Civil, Structural or Pipeline Engineering.
• Minimum 20 years' experience in pipeline engineering, preferably within consulting, owner/operator or EPC environments.
• Demonstrated experience delivering projects from Concept to Detailed design as well as construction support and commissioning startup
• Experience working with oil and gas transmission pipelines, gathering systems, trunklines and multi-product liquid pipelines.
• Experience supporting major operators, midstream companies, utilities or energy infrastructure owners.
• Experience leading engineering teams and managing technical interfaces.
• Proven ability to manage client relationships and deliver commercially focused engineering solutions.

Candidates should possess a strong working knowledge of the following standards and design codes:

Australian Standards

  • AS 2885 Series – Pipelines – Gas and Liquid Petroleum

ASME Codes

  • ASME B31.4 – Pipeline Transportation Systems for Liquids and Slurries.
  • ASME B31.8 – Gas Transmission and Distribution Piping Systems.

Knowledge of broader ASME B31 code requirements and interface considerations

Preferred

  • Long-distance transmission pipelines.
  • Pipeline repurposing and asset requalification.
  • Brownfield pipeline modifications.
  • Pipeline integrity management programmes.
  • Multi-discipline EPC and EPCM project delivery.
  • Experience across international projects

Why join us?

  • Work with great people to make a difference
  • Collaborate on exciting projects to develop innovative solutions
  • Top employer

What we offer you?

  • Flexible work environment
  • Long term career development
  • Think globally, work locally

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations across HR and enterprise systems.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Workday and platforms including Payroll, Benefits, IAM, Recruiting, Learning, and third-party applications.
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, Security, IT teams, and vendors to gather requirements and deliver effective integration solutions.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues, perform root cause analysis, and support production incident resolution.
  • Ensure data accuracy, security, compliance, and operational stability across employee lifecycle processes.
  • Support Workday releases, regulatory changes, system enhancements, and business process improvements.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, testing artifacts, and support procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvements in integration reliability, monitoring, automation, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, and administrators to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality HR technology solutions.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise:

7-8 years relevant experience in,

  • Experience supporting, developing, and maintaining enterprise integrations with Workday as a system of record.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration technologies (e.g., Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, APIs, Workday Web Services).
  • Understanding of Hire-to-Retire business processes, including worker lifecycle events, payroll, benefits, and compensation data flows.
  • Experience integrating Workday or other SaaS applications with downstream systems such as payroll providers, benefits vendors, identity and access management platforms, or third-party service providers.

  • Working knowledge of integration technologies and data formats including XML, JSON, REST, SOAP, and file-based integrations.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting Workday HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, Learning, Time Tracking, or Absence integrations.
  • Experience supporting global or multi-country HRIS integrations.
  • Familiarity with HR data privacy, security, and audit requirements related to employee data.
  • Workday Integration Certification or willingness to obtain certification.
  • Experience working with SaaS vendors and external integration partners.
  • Experience participating in system implementations, enhancements, or enterprise HR technology projects.
  • And/or Master Certified Technical Specialist.

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Effective at establishing overall goals, developing outcome focused CSP (Customer Success Plans), and action plans to achieve results, has a keen sense of what, when and how to communicate information to management and peers and the actions taken and possible solutions. SpryPoint is modernizing how utilities serve their communities. As a high-growth software company, we're shaking up the status quo in the utility industry with the first and only truly cloud-native customer service and operations platform purpose-built for modern utilities.
Founded by industry veterans in 2011, we've grown from a profitable startup to a rapidly scaling company of 300+ employees serving 100+ utility clients across North America and the Caribbean. Our mission is simple: utility leaders should expect more from their technology providers.

raw.description:
RedSeal, a pioneer in preemptive exposure management and winner of the SC Award for Best CTEM Solution, helps organizations see, understand, and secure their hybrid digital environments across IT (on-prem, cloud, and remote workers), OT, and IoT. By dynamically modeling the entire environment, RedSeal uncovers hidden assets, misconfigurations, and lateral attack paths, prioritizes exposures based on business-critical impact with Risk Radius™, and continuously validates compliance with internal policies and industry standards. Trusted by hundreds of Fortune 1000 companies and more than 75 U.S. government agencies, including all five branches of the U.S. military, RedSeal strengthens resilience, streamlines operations, and reduces business risk. Learn more at www.redseal.net.

Overview
As a Sales Engineer, you will establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with customers as you communicate to understand their hybrid environment, security architecture, and operations, and help them define their exposure management objectives while mapping them to RedSeal capabilities. This role requires hands-on leadership to resolution of technical/integration problems effectively escalating critical issues of both technical and operational natures. You will provide standard and customized training on the RedSeal platform while providing accurate, complete and timely written documentation for all project phases. You must have demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with customer representatives at all levels of the organization, from highly technical to senior management.


Performance Objectives
A RedSeal Sales Engineer performs a wide variety of technical sales activities including:
  • Partnering with Sales Directors to plan and execute technical sales strategies for each account, including briefings, demonstrations, proposals, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and technical issue resolution.
  • Establishing and proactively maintaining value-added relationships with customers and partners.
  • Conducting technical discovery to identify customer requirements, use cases, success criteria, and potential obstacles to a successful evaluation.
  • Assessing the customer's IT, OT, IoT, cloud, and hybrid environments, including their security architecture, existing technologies, and operational processes.
  • Understanding the customer's cybersecurity and exposure management objectives and mapping them to RedSeal capabilities and measurable business outcomes.

Required

  • Working knowledge of government procurement: contract vehicles, GWACs, cooperative agreements, fiscal-year cycles, and the reseller/distributor channel

Why Bitwarden

raw.description:
Who we are

Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 30 people globally.

Why we are hiring

We run a creator community on TikTok Shop that just took off. Our creators need someone who has done it, consistently, to show them what works. We are looking for one active creator to coach them on a monthly retainer, a couple of hours a day, without giving up your own channels.

You would work directly with our CMO and co-founder and with our TikTok Shop manager.

What you will own

  • Coaching. Helping and training our creators in Discord: hooks, formats, what to post and what to stop posting.

  • Group calls. One or two a week with the community.

  • Content. Making videos with us until we find the formats that win, then teaching the community to make them.

  • Standards. Telling us which creators are worth more samples and which are not.

What this role is not

This is not a full-time job, not a management role and not a UGC contract. You keep your own channels and your own business; this sits beside them.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been consistently profitable on TikTok Shop for at least the last 12 months, every month, not one spike.

  • You have survived bans and algorithm changes and you know why.

  • Your content is the kind people watch for a minute: commentary, clips, stories, not bottom-of-funnel offer spam.

  • You understand direct response and you can explain why a video sold.

  • You like teaching and you are patient with people who are two steps behind you.

What is hard about this

  • We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

  • Our creators are at every level. Some need basics, some need a push.

  • Our category has claim restrictions, so some of what works elsewhere does not work here.

  • We will ask you to make content for a brand that is not yours until the formats are proven.

The engagement

Type

Monthly retainer, independent contractor. Roughly one to two hours a day, reachable during US business hours.

Compensation

Monthly retainer, set with the person. Tell us your expectation when you apply.

Location

Remote, US.

Reports to

Our CMO and co-founder.

Start

As soon as possible.

How to apply

Send us your TikTok handle plus short answers to three questions:

  1. Your last 12 months on TikTok Shop, month by month. A screenshot is fine.

  2. The one thing most creators in supplements and wellness get wrong, and what you do instead.
