title: Head of Marketing & Growth
description: UtiliSave has recovered over $700 million in utility refunds and savings for large commercial and industrial clients — hospitals, universities, commercial buildings, hotels, and government facilities — across the United States.

raw.title: Head of Marketing & Growth
raw.excerpt: UtiliSave has recovered over $700 million in utility refunds and savings for large commercial and industrial clients — hospitals, universities, commercial buildings, hotels, and government facilities — across the United States.
raw.description:
UtiliSave has recovered over $700 million in utility refunds and savings for large commercial and industrial clients — hospitals, universities, commercial buildings, hotels, and government facilities — across the United States. We find actionable savings in 94% of the accounts we audit, including clients previously reviewed by other firms. We work on a pure contingency basis: if we recover nothing, the client pays nothing. And we are not done. We are marching towards One Billion dollars, and we need the marketing leader who will help us get there.

This is not a role for someone who wants to execute someone else's playbook. We are looking for a senior B2B marketing professional who will own UtiliSave's brand, lead generation engine, and thought leadership platform, building on 35 years of industry credibility to drive measurable pipeline growth and establish UtiliSave and its CEO as the authoritative voice in utility cost recovery.

We are seeking a senior B2B marketing leader who brings deep expertise in digital marketing, content strategy, paid media, and lead generation — with the strategic instincts and executional discipline to translate UtiliSave's extraordinary track record into the dominant brand in utility cost recovery. The right candidate will own our CEO thought leadership platform, amplifying UtiliSave's standing through LinkedIn, industry media, speaking engagements, and content that positions us ahead of competitors who cannot match our 35-year track record.

UtiliSave's success is driven by out-of-the-box thinking, a ceaseless energy to achieve success on behalf of our clients, and the ability to uncover novel opportunities within a complex set of rules. We expect our marketing leader to bring the same traits: intellectual curiosity, creative problem-solving, and an ownership mentality that produces measurable results — not just activity.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building and executing B2B marketing programs that generate measurable pipeline, not just impressions. This person is as comfortable setting strategy as rolling up their sleeves to execute. You may be writing a LinkedIn post in the morning, briefing a paid media campaign at noon, and reviewing performance analytics against pipeline targets in the afternoon. This is a senior role with a direct line of influence on company revenue.

What You Will Own

This role carries direct ownership across three domains:

  • Brand & Thought Leadership: UtiliSave's market position, CEO personal brand on LinkedIn and industry platforms, speaking and PR pipeline, and all external content and messaging.
  • Demand Generation: End-to-end digital marketing — SEO/SEM, paid media, email, and content — with accountability to pipeline metrics, not campaign metrics.
  • Marketing Operations: Budget, analytics stack, CRM integration, reporting cadence, and continuous channel optimization against measurable revenue outcomes.

What You Will Build Here

You are joining as UtiliSave's founding marketing leader — the person who establishes the function, sets the standards, and defines how UtiliSave goes to market. As the business scales toward the One-Billion-dollar milestone and beyond, you will help select and build a marketing support team: identifying talent gaps, participating in hiring decisions, and managing and developing the people you bring on. The expectation is not that you do everything alone forever. It is that you build something that lasts.

To apply, email your resume, a brief cover letter, and if available, a portfolio or examples of B2B marketing campaigns you have led to . Use the job title as the subject line. Please include your state of residence, work authorization status, and compensation expectations.

Requirements

Please confirm you meet the following before applying:

  • Full-time remote; core hours 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zone (CT Zone states: Illinois, Missouri, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or active Green Card holder. Visa sponsorship is not available.
    · Must have the certifications and proficiency in the technologies noted in the job description.
    Responsibilities
  • Own the marketing roadmap — setting priorities, allocating budget, tracking performance against pipeline and revenue targets, and continuously optimizing based on data.
  • Develop and execute marketing strategies — social media, email campaigns, content, and all marketing materials — with every initiative measured against its contribution to new client acquisition and brand authority.
  • Lead brand strategy and ensure consistent, differentiated messaging across all touchpoints — ensuring UtiliSave's proof points (94% success rate, $700M+ recovered, 35-year track record, contingency model, legal backstop) are woven into every client-facing communication.
  • Own and optimize all digital marketing channels — SEO/SEM, LinkedIn paid media (the primary B2B channel for this audience), Google Ads, email marketing, and website performance — with clear KPIs tied to lead volume, lead quality, and cost per acquired client.
  • Conduct and supervise research to monitor market trends, competitive activity, and client behavior — identifying gaps and white space that UtiliSave can own before competitors do.
  • Build and execute the CEO thought leadership platform: speaking engagements, industry publications, podcast opportunities, and LinkedIn content strategy that cement UtiliSave's CEO as the authoritative voice in utility cost recovery.
  • Report on campaign results, ROI, pipeline impact, and brand health to leadership on a regular cadence, using dashboards and attribution data that connect marketing activity to revenue outcomes.
  • Serve as brand guardian for all internal and external communications — ensuring every client touchpoint, proposal, and outreach reflects UtiliSave's positioning with precision and consistency.
  • Participate in the selection and onboarding of marketing support staff as the team grows — setting clear role expectations, managing day-to-day work, and developing team members to expand the marketing function's capacity and reach.
  • Build and manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and freelancers — maintaining quality and cost discipline while scaling output beyond what the internal team can execute alone.
  • Leverage AI tools — including generative AI for content drafting, AI-assisted analytics, and marketing automation powered by machine learning — to maximize output, accelerate campaign cycles, and maintain UtiliSave's competitive edge. UtiliSave is actively integrating AI across its operations and expects its marketing leader to be at the forefront of that adoption.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field required. MBA or advanced degree a plus.
  • 6+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 2 years in a strategy-owning or marketing leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring direct reports, junior staff, or agency/vendor teams — with a track record of developing talent and expanding team output.
  • Proven success building and executing B2B strategic marketing plans that drove measurable pipeline growth — not just brand awareness. References and portfolio of results required.
  • Deep knowledge of digital marketing, paid media, SEO/SEM, and performance analytics with a proven ability to tie channel performance to pipeline and revenue, not just impressions and clicks.
  • Deep familiarity with LinkedIn as a B2B marketing and thought leadership platform including LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Newsletter, and organic content strategy for company pages and executive profiles. LinkedIn is the primary channel for reaching UtiliSave's target buyer (CFOs, VPs of Real Estate Operations, Facilities Directors at large commercial and institutional organizations) and hands-on expertise is required, not optional.
  • Current certifications in Google Ads, LinkedIn Marketing, SEO, and email marketing/CRM platforms strongly preferred. Certifications demonstrate currency — this industry moves fast and we expect our marketing leader to stay ahead of it.
  • Experience with CRM systems (HubSpot or Salesforce preferred), marketing automation tools, and data visualization/reporting platforms.
  • Experience with graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Photoshop) and video editing software — with the ability to produce professional-quality content independently when needed.
  • Experience with website management platforms (WordPress preferred; Squarespace or Wix acceptable).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools — generative AI for content creation, AI-assisted analytics platforms, and machine learning-driven marketing automation. UtiliSave is actively integrating AI across its operations; the successful candidate leads that adoption, not follows it.
  • Self-starter with a proactive, creative mindset and an ownership mentality — this person does not wait to be told what the next initiative is.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines under tight time constraints.
  • Ability to communicate clearly at all levels — from writing a LinkedIn post the CEO is proud to publish to present pipeline analytics to the leadership team.

Additional Information

  • UtiliSave is growing rapidly and this role grows with the company. As UtiliSave expands its client base toward the One-Billion-dollar milestone, the marketing function will scale in budget, headcount, and strategic influence. You will be its architect.

Benefits

o Base salary: $85,000–$110,000 per year, commensurate with experience

o Performance bonus: year-end bonus and merit increases tied directly to delivered results

o Health, dental, and vision insurance

o 401(k) with company match

o 3 weeks paid time off to start, plus 11 paid holidays

o Full-time remote

raw.excerpt: ABOUT WORLDWIDE MISSION CRITICAL Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget.
raw.description:
ABOUT WORLDWIDE MISSION CRITICAL
Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget. Founded on the principle that the right team of experienced data center professionals will deliver great projects, our ability to provide oversight for all aspects of a project sets us apart.

Summary

    As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will play a critical role in guiding the planning, coordination, and execution of advanced electrical systems on large-scale infrastructure projects. You will work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners to ensure that all designs are technically robust, code-compliant, and aligned with project objectives. Your focus will be on delivering reliable, efficient, and scalable electrical solutions while upholding safety, quality, cost, and schedule commitments.

Primary Responsibilities

  • You will serve as a key liaison between internal departments, external consultants, contractors, and the Engineer of Record (EoR) to troubleshoot and resolve electrical design challenges.

  • You will lead the development and review of electrical documents, including one-line diagrams, load calculations, panel schedules, submittals, technical studies, and RFIs.

  • You will research and develop emerging trends and new technologies to optimize electrical systems and infrastructure in data centers, enhancing efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

  • You will be responsible for ensuring the timely delivery of design packages by identifying bottlenecks, introducing efficiencies, and proactively managing evolving project requirements.

  • You will ensure electrical systems meet all applicable codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, IEC) while maintaining design quality and mitigating technical risk.

  • You will contribute to budget management by evaluating the cost impact of design changes, tracking electrical expenditures, and analyzing contractual obligations tied to the EoR.

  • You will participate in risk assessment and commissioning efforts, including factory and site acceptance testing, milestone inspections, and integration verification.

  • You will coordinate closely with mechanical, controls, and architectural teams to ensure the electrical systems are fully integrated into the broader design framework.

  • You will mentor and support junior engineers, reinforcing consistent design practices and ensuring knowledge continuity across the team.

  • You will help capture lessons learned and apply them to improve future design processes, standards, and project outcomes.

  • You will support construction activities in the field, resolving installation issues, conducting walkthroughs, and ensuring a successful handoff to operations.

Skills, Knowledge, Education, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Engineering with electrical building systems emphasis.

  • Revit BIM design experience required.

  • Proficiency in power distribution and lighting design, including controls implementation.

  • Experience with short circuit analysis and utilization of analytical modeling software such as SKM or similar tools.

  • Strong background in the design, construction, and commissioning of medium and low voltage electrical distribution systems, and power management or SCADA tools.

  • Preferred qualifications include a Professional Engineering (PE) license.

  • Experience in mission-critical facilities and their electrical/mechanical infrastructure.

  • Knowledge and experience in estimating, electrical design, operation, and commissioning of substations, switchgear, and power monitoring.

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in A/E industry preferred.

  • Comprehensive understanding of professional services from conceptual design through project close-out.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, organizational skills, and ability to motivate and mentor staff.

  • Familiarity with sustainable design approaches and related project impacts.

  • Passion for improving workflows and mentoring team members.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Productivity Suite products.

If you're ready to bring your expertise to a team that's redefining how data centers get built, we'd love to hear from you. At Worldwide Mission Critical, you'll find the support, trust, and room to grow that helped us become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country — and we're just getting started.

Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's enterprise learning business, purpose-built to help organizations develop the technology skills their workforce needs to compete. We deliver high-impact, project-based learning programs at scale — across cloud, AI, data, cybersecurity, and more — partnering with leading global enterprises to close critical skill gaps and drive measurable business outcomes. As our client portfolio grows and our programs scale, operational excellence in delivery has never been more important.


About the Role

The Delivery Services Specialist (DSS) is an individual contributor within the Professional Services division at Accenture LearnVantage. Professional Services is the delivery engine of the business — the team responsible for translating enterprise contracts into live, high-quality learning programs. Delivery Services Specialists sit at the center of this model: owning the technical implementation of each program, managing the ongoing health of their accounts, and serving as the primary operational point of contact for enterprise clients throughout the engagement lifecycle.


Delivery Service Specialists work collaboratively across the Professional Services team and with enterprise client stakeholders, operating with a high degree of autonomy on their accounts. This role is well-suited to professionals who combine technical depth with strong client-facing instincts — expected to diagnose problems, design solutions, and drive outcomes in environments where program quality directly impacts thousands of learners.


Key Responsibilities:

Pre-Sales & Client Onboarding

  • Lead pre-sales alignment meetings with account teams (Customer Success, Account Executives, Solution Architects) to validate delivery fit, scope program requirements, and provide technical insights on integration feasibility.
  • Own the Sales-to-Service handoff process, ensuring smooth transitions with clear documentation of program design, timelines, and client expectations.
  • Guide new clients through onboarding, establishing delivery rhythms and managing expectations from day one.

Technical Implementation

  • Own end-to-end platform setup including account creation, SSO and auto-provisioning, LMS integrations, client enablement on Public API, skills assessment platform configuration, tailored learning plans, cohort setup, and learner enrollments.
  • Manage the full integration lifecycle — requirements gathering, configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance — ensuring each client's technical environment is stable and performant.
  • Partner with the Delivery Operations Specialist on configuration tasks for higher-tier accounts, providing technical direction and reviewing completed work ahead of QA sign-off.

Program Management

  • Manage ongoing program delivery across a large book of business, executing cohort launches, maintaining platform configurations, and enabling customer administrators to self-manage their platform environment.
  • Drive program health through analytics-informed reporting, learner intervention strategies, and post-implementation check-ins — ensuring outcomes align to the CS-defined measurement strategy.
  • Proactively communicate project status, risks, and issues to clients and internal stakeholders, maintaining transparency across the full delivery lifecycle.

Client Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted delivery advisor to enterprise clients — conducting learner interventions, supporting program design with content tailoring, translation, and survey creation, and coordinating license dissemination and management.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Enterprise Sales, Solution Architects, and Product teams to surface delivery risks, align on program strategy, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Handle operational requests including marketing collateral and data team requests, product bug submissions, and thorough documentation of integration configurations and client-specific customizations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a technical delivery, implementation, or professional services role
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a customer-facing role

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong technical proficiency with integration tools, APIs, SSO (SAML/OIDC), and common enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS/LXP), HRIS platforms, and enterprise program management.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple stakeholder relationships simultaneously.
  • Client-focused mindset with strong accountability, ownership, and the ability to manage concurrent client projects without losing quality.
  • Experience reporting on key metrics, distilling learning insights, and identifying opportunities for learner intervention.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and databases.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript).
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience working within the Educational Technologies industry.

Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:


Job Description

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

Abbott Medical Devices, with revenue of $21B in 2025, is a global leader in providing life changing technology for the management and treatment of people living with chronic conditions including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, chronic pain, and movement disorders.


The Opportunity

The Senior Clinical Monitoring Lead (CML) serves as the regional subject matter expert for clinical monitoring quality, oversight, and execution. This role partners with Clinical Site Management Leadership to drive monitoring excellence through report quality review, monitoring performance oversight, training, mentoring, compliance support, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

The Senior CML provides leadership and support to Clinical Site Leads across the region, helping ensure consistent execution of monitoring plans, regulatory compliance, timely issue resolution, and adherence to company standards. As a recognized monitoring expert, the Senior CML acts as a key liaison among field monitoring teams, study teams, and quality functions to support operational effectiveness and inspection readiness.


As a recognized subject matter expert in Site Quality Monitoring, KCI process, SIV, PMV, and COV, the Senior CML will exhibit fluency on monitoring-related clinical data systems and study-specific Monitoring Plans. Along with monitoring their own assigned sites, the Senior CML will provide direct mentorship on monitoring training, execution, and best practices for all Clinical Site Lead’s throughout the region and also serve as a liaison to Field Clinical Quality Managers.


May be consulted in the following areas: study design, site payments, site audits, local document review, study documents preparation, and submission to site or competent authority/ethics committee. Beyond monitoring assigned sites, the Senior CML is a nationally recognized leader/expert in monitoring who provides support, mentoring and guidance to other clinical site management colleagues and consistently delivers prolific contributions to Global Clinical Operations and/or Business Units.


What You’ll Work On

Monitoring Oversight & Compliance

  • Serve as a regional monitoring expert providing oversight of monitoring quality, monitoring documentation, and compliance with study requirements, GCP, and company procedures.
  • Review and provide feedback on monitoring visit reports, monitoring trends, and quality metrics to promote consistency and continuous improvement.
  • Support CAPA activities, issue escalation management, inspection readiness initiatives, and monitoring-related quality investigations.

Training & Development

  • Provide mentoring, coaching, onboarding, and ongoing support to Clinical Site Leads and monitoring personnel.
  • Lead or contribute to monitoring-focused training initiatives and best practice sharing across the organization.

Monitoring Operations Leadership

  • Partner with study teams, regional leadership, and quality functions to identify risks, monitor performance metrics, and drive resolution of monitoring-related issues.
  • Support development and maintenance of monitoring tools, processes, guidance documents, and operational resources.

Strategic Contributions

  • Lead or support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance monitoring effectiveness, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Serve as a monitoring subject matter expert for special projects, audits, inspections, and cross-functional initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • 5 years’ experience in a clinical research environment or other equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of regulations and standards (Good Clinical Practices) for conducting clinical research.
  • Polished communicator: written documentation and oral presentations/discussions/meetings
  • Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
  • Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.
  • Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization.
  • Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail
  • Experience and training on GCP

PreferredQualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biological Sciences, Nursing, or a related field OR equivalent or related experience in cardiology or clinical research.
  • 2 years’ experience as a field clinical monitor specialist
  • 5 years relevant clinical trial experience in the cardiovascular and/or Neuromodulation field.
  • 3 years’ experience as clinical monitor.
  • 5+ years of medical device experience.
  • Experience with GCP, ISO standards, and clinical trial guidelines.
  • Flexibility to work across all US time zones.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring, training, or leading monitoring personnel.
  • Experience supporting monitoring oversight, quality systems, CAPA management, audit readiness, or inspection support activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze monitoring metrics and identify opportunities for process improvement.

raw.description:
Product Designer

Remote (US) | Full-time | Salary + Equity

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to help define how people interact with our product in an AI-native world.

This is not a traditional design role where you receive fully scoped tickets and produce polished mockups in isolation. You’ll work directly with engineering, product, and customers to shape the core product experience from first principles. You’ll design workflows where AI is not a bolt-on feature, but a fundamental part of how users think, decide, create, automate, and get work done.

You should be excited by ambiguity, fast iteration, and the opportunity to help build product experiences that feel dramatically better than the SaaS tools people are used to today. We care about taste, speed, craft, product thinking, and your ability to turn messy product ideas into simple, useful, elegant experiences.

What You’ll Do

You’ll help shape and execute design across our core product experience, from early discovery through shipped products. This includes:

  • Designing AI-native workflows that help users move faster, reduce manual work, and trust the system

  • Translating complex product, data, and automation concepts into intuitive user experiences

  • Partnering closely with engineering and product to rapidly prototype, test, and ship new ideas

  • Creating flows, wireframes, prototypes, interaction models, and high-fidelity product designs

  • Defining UX patterns for AI-assisted experiences, including agents, copilots, approvals, suggestions, generated outputs, human-in-the-loop review, and automation transparency

  • Talking to users, watching how they work, and using those insights to improve the product

  • Building and maintaining a lightweight design system that helps us move quickly without sacrificing quality

  • Improving onboarding, activation, navigation, information architecture, and product clarity

  • Using AI tools as part of your own design workflow to move faster and explore more options

  • Raising the product bar by bringing strong taste, clear thinking, and a deep care for usability

What Makes This Role Different

We are building for a world where software is no longer just forms, dashboards, filters, and static workflows. The best products will increasingly feel like intelligent systems that understand context, anticipate work, and help users accomplish outcomes with less friction.

That creates new design challenges:

  • How should users understand what the AI knows and does not know?

  • When should the product act automatically versus ask for approval?

  • How do we make AI-generated work trustworthy, editable, and explainable?

  • How do we help users feel in control without making them do unnecessary manual work?

  • How do we design interfaces that combine deterministic software, probabilistic AI, and human judgment?

You’ll help answer these questions through real product work.

What We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have 3–5 years of product design experience working on complex software, ideally B2B, SaaS, developer tools, data products, productivity tools, or AI products

  • Have excellent UX and product instincts, with the ability to translate customer problems into clear requirements and simplify complicated workflows without losing power or flexibility.

  • Are comfortable working from rough ideas, customer problems, or technical concepts rather than polished product specs

  • Can move quickly from low-fidelity exploration to high-quality shipped design

  • Have strong visual design taste and care about details, hierarchy, spacing, interaction, and clarity

  • Are comfortable working directly with engineers and product leaders

  • Can explain your design decisions clearly and invite critique without becoming defensive

  • Are curious about AI and actively use AI tools in your own work

  • Have a bias toward shipping and learning rather than perfecting work in a vacuum

  • Are ambitious, take ownership of your work, and are eager to develop stronger product thinking and strategic design skills over time

AI-Native Design Experience

You do not need to have spent years designing AI products, but you should be deeply interested in them. We want someone who is actively experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Figma AI, Midjourney, Runway, or similar tools to accelerate research, prototyping, ideation, writing, and production.

We’re especially excited about designers who think AI changes the product design process itself. You should be interested in using AI to generate concepts, test flows, analyze user feedback, write microcopy, prototype faster, and explore product directions that would have previously taken much longer.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing AI copilots, agents, automation tools, workflow builders, or data-heavy interfaces

  • Experience designing for operations teams, product teams, engineering teams, or internal tools

  • Experience with front-end implementation, design engineering, or prototyping in code

  • Comfort working in Figma, Framer, v0, Cursor, React, or similar tools

How We Work

We move quickly, stay close to users, and expect everyone on the team to operate with high ownership. You’ll work closely with founders, product, design, and engineering to identify the highest-leverage opportunities and turn them into shipped product.

We value people who are:

  • High agency

  • Clear communicators

  • Intellectually honest

  • Low ego

  • Strong collaborators

  • Deeply curious

  • Comfortable with ambiguity

  • Obsessed with building useful products

You Might Love This Role If

You want to help define the product experience of an AI-first company from the ground up. You enjoy taking vague, complex problems and turning them into simple, elegant workflows. You like working directly with engineers and customers. You care about speed, taste, and impact. You believe AI will fundamentally change how software is designed and used, and you want to be one of the people shaping that future.

You Might Not Love This Role If

You prefer clear specs, defined handoffs, and a UXR team to run a research phase before design begins. You want what a bigger, established design org gives you: a mature design system, and room to specialize in a narrower part of the product. This role trades that for breadth, speed, and proximity to messy product decisions.

What You’ll Bring

Please share a portfolio or examples of product work that show how you think. We care less about perfectly polished case studies and more about your ability to reason through complex problems, simplify workflows, and ship high-quality product experiences.

Strong examples might include:

  • A complex workflow you made simpler

  • A product experience you designed from zero to one

  • A before-and-after redesign with measurable impact

  • A design system or interaction pattern you created

  • An AI, automation, data, or productivity product you worked on

  • A prototype or side project that shows your taste and initiative

We are hiring a Retail & CPG Senior Sales Account Manager for the UK who is eager to discover growth opportunities in Retail & CPG. This role involves growing customer value and applying partnership strategies. The aim is to move into new markets, promote NVIDIA technology solutions, and lead the market. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to work with modern technology and collaborate with world-class teams dedicated to innovation. We are looking for someone who is ready to compete in a dynamic environment and make a significant impact!

What you'll be doing:

  • Quantify the market opportunity, craft a strategy, define initiatives and outcomes, and orchestrate resources to achieve those outcomes. We need you to analyse and segment market opportunities and develop strategic business plans around them.

  • Strategically partner with lighthouse customers and industry-specific application and other solution partners targeting our computing platform.

  • Act as the main liaison for the Retail & CPG network in the UK.

  • Build partner and customer references and case studies.

  • Watch for and develop emerging use cases to help cultivate new vertical opportunities.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience from a leading University, Master’s/MBA.

  • Over 6 years or substantial professional experience in the Retail & CPG sectors.

  • Extensive knowledge and significant experience in business growth within the Retail & CPG sector, along with encouraging adoption and expansion of digital solutions.

  • Leverage success to foster community marketing & business development. Communicate and complete success stories working with campaign, corporate, & partner marketing teams.

  • Take part in Retail & CPG industry events to represent NVIDIA and connect with the ecosystem in the UK.

  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation communication skills are a crucial requirement. Candidates must work comfortably across all major internal functional areas (engineering, sales, marketing, executives), as well as external partners, customers, and content developers.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Machine learning, data analytics, and artificial intelligence experience preferred.

  • Understanding of AI Native and Software provider landscape for Retail & CPG.

  • Innovative and creative flair, yet able to follow operational processes.

If you're ready to take on this outstanding opportunity and help NVIDIA continue to lead the world in technology innovation, apply now!

You’d join an existing team of about 10 people doing this work, in a generalist, high-ownership role with a path to management. This role is fully remote within India, on night shifts 6 days a week.

  • Review AI-generated scheduling actions and messages before they go to executive search firms and their candidates

  • Make real-time calls on ambiguous cases, such as tone, rescheduling requests, and missing context from earlier in a thread

  • Catch errors in time zones, intent, tone, and thread context before they reach clients

  • Flag recurring AI behavior patterns to the founders and product team

  • Help design the playbooks the AI learns from, and take on adjacent operations projects

  • Excellent written and spoken English, at a TOEFL iBT 110+ level

  • Sound judgment under time pressure, with consistent reliability shift after shift

  • Degree from a top-tier university

  • Equity: Competitive Equity

  • Visa Sponsorship: None Available

  • Work Type: Remote

  • Data labeling experience

  • English, literature or writing majors moving into AI or operations

  • Big 4 or equivalent background

  • Strong personality and a proven ability to grind

Red Flags to reject your application

  • Comes across as high ego or a know-it-all

  • Doesn’t use AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude day to day

raw.description:
Description

The ideal candidates will have strong hands-on experience installing, configuring, customizing, and enhancing the NICE Actimize platform, particularly ActOne, Unified Data Model (UDM), and AML Transaction Monitoring solutions.

This is a highly technical development role requiring expertise in Actimize platform implementation, ActOne customization, AML model configuration, custom rule development, SQL, and Python scripting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade NICE Actimize components, including AIS, ActOne/RCM, UDM, and AML solutions across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Customize ActOne using ActOne Designer, including alert and case types, workflows, forms, queues, business units, roles, permissions, policies, and notifications.
  • Develop, customize, and deploy ActOne plugins to extend alert and case-management functionality and integrate with enterprise applications.
  • Configure and enhance UDM, ensuring accurate mapping and integration of source data for AML detection and monitoring.
  • Clone and customize out-of-the-box AML models based on business requirements, including thresholds, segmentation, scoring, and tuning parameters.
  • Develop custom AML detection rules based on functional specifications and validate their effectiveness through unit testing.
  • Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and database views supporting AML detection and data validation.
  • Develop Python scripts for automation, data analysis, test-data preparation, and deployment support.
  • Manage configuration packaging and migration across environments in accordance with enterprise change-management and release processes.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, including batch failures, performance bottlenecks, data discrepancies, and unexpected alert volumes.
  • Prepare technical documentation, solution designs, deployment guides, and operational runbooks.
  • Participate in code reviews, configuration reviews, Agile ceremonies, and technical discussions with client stakeholders.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on NICE Actimize development or implementation experience within the banking or financial services industry.
  • Strong experience installing and configuring NICE Actimize components, including AIS, ActOne/RCM, UDM, and AML solutions.
  • Hands-on expertise with ActOne Designer, including workflow configuration, forms, alert and case management, policies, and access controls.
  • Experience developing, customizing, and deploying ActOne plugins.
  • Strong understanding of UDM architecture, data models, configuration, and source-to-detection data flows.
  • Hands-on experience with NICE Actimize AML Transaction Monitoring (SAM), including:
    • Cloning and customizing out-of-the-box models.
    • Developing custom AML detection rules.
    • Configuring thresholds, segmentation, and scoring parameters.
    • Model tuning and validation.
  • Strong SQL skills with Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, and data analysis.
  • Experience managing code and configuration deployments across multiple environments.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.
  • Understanding of AML transaction monitoring, alert generation, and case investigation workflows.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments with globally distributed teams.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to interact directly with client and technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with NICE Actimize platform upgrades, migrations, or major implementation programs.
  • Java development experience, particularly for ActOne plugin development and integration-related work.
  • Prior experience supporting capital markets or investment banking AML programs.
  • Familiarity with additional NICE Actimize solutions, such as Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Watch List Filtering (WLF).
  • Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and shell scripting.
  • Experience with enterprise scheduling tools such as Control-M or AutoSys.
  • NICE Actimize product training or relevant certifications.

WHY JOIN US

﻿Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast‑growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

To learn more, visit: www.matrix-ifs.com

Matrix is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Matrix are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in our locations. Matrix will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Matrix encourages applicants of all ages.

raw.description:
Position Overview

MetroSys is seeking a highly experienced Senior AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect to support the design, planning, and implementation of advanced artificial intelligence computing environments for enterprise organizations.

This position requires a technical leader with extensive experience in GPU-accelerated infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), enterprise networking, storage architecture, and AI platform integration.

The ideal candidate will combine deep infrastructure engineering expertise with the ability to advise customers on complex technology investments, develop scalable solutions, and translate business requirements into practical architecture designs.

This individual will collaborate with engineering teams, technical stakeholders, and business leadership to develop infrastructure solutions capable of supporting demanding AI workloads, including large language models (LLMs), machine learning, model training, and enterprise inference applications.

The role requires both hands-on technical knowledge and the ability to lead architectural discussions with senior IT executives.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise AI Infrastructure Architecture

  • Design enterprise-scale infrastructure environments supporting AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads.

  • Develop architecture solutions integrating GPU compute platforms, high-throughput networking, enterprise storage, and workload orchestration technologies.

  • Evaluate infrastructure requirements based on application performance, scalability, resource utilization, and operational costs.

  • Produce technical architecture documentation, infrastructure diagrams, hardware specifications, and implementation plans.

  • Lead infrastructure discovery sessions and technical workshops to identify customer requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.

  • Design solutions supporting on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid AI computing environments.

  • Assess existing data center infrastructure and recommend upgrades necessary to support GPU-intensive computing.

GPU Computing and Accelerated Infrastructure

  • Architect solutions utilizing NVIDIA accelerated computing technologies and alternative GPU platforms.

  • Provide technical guidance on NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and enterprise GPU computing environments.

  • Evaluate NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell architectures for AI training and inference requirements.

  • Design scalable GPU clusters supporting distributed computing and resource-intensive AI applications.

  • Support GPU platform sizing, performance analysis, capacity planning, and infrastructure optimization.

  • Evaluate AMD Instinct and Intel accelerator technologies when appropriate for customer workloads.

  • Assess infrastructure dependencies including rack density, power distribution, cooling, and physical data center capacity.

High-Performance Networking and Storage

  • Develop high-bandwidth network architectures designed for distributed GPU processing and AI applications.

  • Design and evaluate InfiniBand, RoCE, and high-speed Ethernet connectivity solutions.

  • Integrate high-performance storage platforms supporting large-scale data processing and model training.

  • Evaluate NVMe-based storage, parallel file systems, and distributed storage technologies.

  • Identify network and storage bottlenecks that could affect AI workload performance.

  • Collaborate with network, storage, and data center engineering teams to ensure infrastructure interoperability.

AI Platforms, Automation, and Workload Management

  • Design infrastructure platforms supporting containerized AI applications and distributed computing workloads.

  • Implement architectural solutions involving Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift AI, and Linux-based computing environments.

  • Evaluate workload management platforms including NVIDIA Run:ai, Slurm, and other GPU scheduling technologies.

  • Provide architectural guidance for NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA NIM, NVIDIA Mission Control, and related AI infrastructure software.

  • Support integration of MLOps platforms used for model development, training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Develop infrastructure automation strategies to improve deployment consistency, operational efficiency, and resource utilization.

  • Assist with capacity planning and performance optimization for AI training and inference workloads.

Infrastructure Security and Governance

  • Incorporate enterprise security requirements into AI infrastructure architecture.

  • Design secure environments supporting sensitive datasets, proprietary AI models, and regulated workloads.

  • Implement architectural controls supporting workload isolation, identity management, access control, and infrastructure monitoring.

  • Evaluate security considerations associated with shared GPU resources and multi-tenant computing environments.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to align infrastructure solutions with applicable organizational and regulatory requirements.

  • Provide guidance on infrastructure logging, observability, auditability, and operational resilience.

Technical Consulting and Solution Development

  • Serve as a senior technical advisor during customer discovery, solution planning, and architecture engagements.

  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into actionable infrastructure recommendations.

  • Work with technical sales and delivery teams to develop solution designs, equipment requirements, implementation strategies, and project estimates.

  • Present proposed architectures to technical teams, IT leadership, and executive stakeholders.

  • Evaluate competing technology solutions and provide objective recommendations based on performance, cost, and business requirements.

  • Develop reusable technical documentation, architecture standards, and solution frameworks.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and architects.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging AI infrastructure technologies and evolving industry architecture practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure architecture, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or related disciplines.

  • Significant experience designing complex data center or high-performance computing environments.

  • Strong knowledge of NVIDIA GPU computing technologies and enterprise AI infrastructure.

  • Experience with accelerated computing platforms, GPU cluster architecture, and infrastructure sizing.

  • Advanced understanding of enterprise networking, including high-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand, or RoCE.

  • Experience designing enterprise storage architectures for high-throughput and performance-sensitive workloads.

  • Strong knowledge of Linux operating systems, virtualization, containerization, and Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure software, GPU orchestration, and workload scheduling technologies.

  • Experience producing high-level designs, detailed technical specifications, and infrastructure implementation documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead customer-facing technical discussions and communicate complex solutions to senior stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure scalability, availability, performance, and security principles.

  • Ability to collaborate across compute, storage, networking, security, and application engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, or comparable accelerated computing platforms.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM, Run:ai, Mission Control, and related technologies.

  • Experience with AMD Instinct GPU platforms or other accelerator architectures.

  • Knowledge of distributed AI training, inference optimization, and large language model infrastructure requirements.

  • Experience with Red Hat OpenShift AI or other enterprise Kubernetes environments.

  • Familiarity with Slurm and GPU resource scheduling platforms.

  • Experience supporting enterprise AI infrastructure deployments in regulated environments.

  • Understanding of NIST, FedRAMP, CMMC, or comparable security frameworks.

  • Experience with GPU-dense data center infrastructure, including power and cooling considerations.

  • Python scripting or infrastructure automation experience.

  • Relevant NVIDIA, cloud architecture, Linux, Kubernetes, or enterprise infrastructure certifications.

  • Experience supporting technical pre-sales engagements, solution development, or enterprise consulting initiatives.

Role Summary

The Operations Client Account Lead is the single point of accountability for an Operations account. They own the client relationship at the operational level, the financial performance of the contract, and the growth of the account. They make sure the services promised in the contract are delivered to standard and profitably. They also look for chances to expand the relationship through transformation and new scope.

Key Responsibilities

Client relationship

  • Serve as the primary senior contact for client operations leaders. Build trusted relationships across the client's business and procurement functions.
  • Lead governance forums such as quarterly business reviews, steering committees, and executive check-ins. Use these to keep both sides aligned on priorities, performance, and roadmap.

Account financials and contract management

  • Own account P&L, including revenue, CCI (Contract Controllable Income), and margin. Protect and improve profitability against the Original Deal Economics (ODE).
  • Manage the contract lifecycle, including change requests, scope changes, pricing adjustments, and renewals. Resolve commercial disputes before they escalate.
  • Forecast accurately and report account performance to leadership.

Delivery oversight

  • Partner with delivery leads to make sure SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards are consistently met. Step in quickly when performance slips.
  • Identify operational risks early and drive mitigation plans across people, process, and technology.

Growth and transformation

  • Identify and shape new opportunities, including scope extensions, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled process improvements. Work with Delivery & Transformation (D&T) teams to bring them to the client.
  • Build a multi-year account plan that ties operational improvements to the client's business outcomes.

Team leadership

  • Lead and coordinate a cross-functional account team spanning delivery, finance, solutioning, and HR. Coach team members and build bench strength for key roles.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in client account management, operations delivery, or managed services. The usual range is 10+ years, adjusted to the target level.
  • A proven track record of owning P&L and contract economics on large, multi-year service contracts.
  • Strong grasp of operations domains such as Procurement & all Command Center functions (Risk & Compliance, Learning, Quality, Insights and Intelligence, Business Reporting Groups & Executive Governance). Familiarity with process transformation and automation is also expected.
  • Executive presence and the ability to handle difficult commercial conversations with senior client stakeholders.
  • Experience leading global or distributed teams, including offshore delivery centers.
  • A bachelor's degree is required, and an MBA or relevant certification is a plus.

Success Measures

  • Client satisfaction and relationship health scores.
  • Account CCI and margin performance versus ODE and plan.
  • SLA and KPI attainment.
  • Contract renewals and growth in sales and revenue from the account.
  • Team engagement and retention.

POSITION PURPOSE

Serves as a member of the performance management team responsible for performance improvement projects for a defined population of Trinity Health Revenue Excellence. Responsible for implementing opportunities for enhancement and/or standardization initiatives and supporting the long-term success and sustainability of those initiatives. Provides regular collaboration with System Office, Regional Health Ministry (RHM) leadership, and Patient Business Services (PBS) managers in order to achieve sustained success in transformational initiatives and the pursuit of continuous improvement. This position reports to the regional Manager Performance Management.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Knows, understands, incorporates, and demonstrates the Trinity Health Mission, Vision, and Values in behaviors, practices, and decisions.


Utilizes a basic understanding of end-to-end revenue cycle processes and identifies opportunities for performance improvement.


Serves as an expert with knowledge of best known practices in at least one functional area. Maintains and enhances existing tools to support functional area.


Manages vendor relations which support revenue cycle functions across region.


Identifies deviations from best known practice performance and processes.


Utilizes performance improvement methodologies (e.g., PDCA, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.) and change management strategies to address gaps in performance, changing technology, regulations, standards and evidence.


Provides seasoned guidance and consultation to leaders in understanding, embracing, developing and implementing successful change management strategies and understanding and utilizing process improvement methodologies to support the advancement of goals and objective. Identifies areas that present challenges and opportunities; makes recommendations that provide practical options and solutions while considering the impact on processes, workforce, culture and technology.


Facilitates varied interests, cross functional teams and groups through effective leadership, communication, collaboration and negotiation abilities in order to achieve mutual agreeable solutions.


Utilizes critical thinking, strong analytical skills and proficient abilities with Microsoft Excel.


Independently collects, synthesizes and analyzes data, identifies root cause, and provides summaries and graphical presentations of data illustrating trends with recommended next steps to manager.


Serves as the primary point of contact for RHM and PBS managers.


Other duties as needed and assigned by the manager.


Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and local laws and regulations, Trinity Health’s Integrity and Compliance Program and Code of Conduct, as well as other policies and procedures in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical, and professional behavior.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Must possess a comprehensive knowledge of end to end revenue cycle strategies, as normally obtained through a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Industrial Engineering or Healthcare Administration or a related field, and at least three (3) to five (5) years of revenue cycle, project management or consulting experience with healthcare clients driving transformational efforts or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Broad based and comprehensive knowledge of accounting systems and insurance issues, healthcare industry issues and trends, legal issues in field of expertise, required third party and governmental guidelines, and work processing methods and techniques.


Possesses a basic understanding of end-to-end revenue cycle processes and ability to identify opportunities for performance improvement.


Demonstrated experience and proficiency in managing performance/business process improvement activities and applying continuous improvement methodologies, including analyzing workflow processes utilizing PDCA, Lean, Six Sigma or other process improvement methodologies.


Strong project leadership, organization, integration and execution skills and abilities. Reasonable experience in planning, formulating and executing strategies, as well as the ability to define program, process or business objectives and scope.


Supervisory or team leader experience preferred.


Demonstrated proficiency to identify, evaluate and articulate operational opportunities, business needs and gaps, plan and implement project steps, understand stakeholder interest and provide authoritative consultation.


Excellent organizational, advanced analytical, presentation, interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills. Ability to translate technical matters to operations staff, facilitate communications between diverse groups and to effectively assess and facilitate improvements and solutions and to provide productive working partnerships, advice and authoritative recommendations to all levels of the organization.


Proven customer-service orientation and strong interpersonal, consultative and relationship building skills. Ability to know and understand customer requirements and exercise judgment in meeting reasonable expectations, particularly when differences of opinion on needs and services, unanticipated contingencies or divergent ideas and perspectives exist. Ability to influence results, garner support and tactfully manage complex relationships and influences within and across the organization. Ability to read the subtle nuances of situations and react/plan accordingly.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.


Knowledge of contract negotiation, drafting, and contract law and regulatory language.


Ability to work independently or as a team member.


Must be comfortable operating in a collaborative, shared leadership environment.


Must possess a personal presence that is characterized by a sense of honesty, integrity, and caring with the ability to inspire and motivate others to promote the philosophy, mission, vision, goals, and values of Trinity Health.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORKING CONDITIONS


This position operates in a typical office environment. The area is well lit, temperature controlled and free from hazards.


Incumbent communicates frequently, in person and over the phone, with people in all locations on product support issues.


Manual dexterity is needed to operate a keyboard. Hearing is needed for extensive telephone and in person communication.


The environment in which the incumbent will work requires the ability to concentrate, meet deadlines, work on several projects at the same time and adapt to interruptions.


Must be able to set and organize own work priorities, and adapt to them as they change frequently. Must be able to work concurrently on a variety of tasks/projects in an environment that may be stressful with individuals having diverse personalities and work styles.


Must be able to travel to the various Trinity Health sites as needed.


Must possess the ability to comply with Trinity Health policies and procedures.

raw.description:
Claims Counsel

Location: Preference for New York, NY, Philadelphia, Chicago, or Austin, but open to Remote

About WithCoverage:

WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.

We partner with hundreds of high-growth, category-defining companies, including GoPuff, Eight Sleep, Bombas, Chomps, and Blank Street Coffee. Our clients span iconic consumer brands, hospitality leaders, GCs, advanced manufacturers, and next-generation defense contractors. They operate in complex risk environments and need a partner that can move at their speed.

Instead of a fragmented, manual brokerage stack, we have built a new category: elite risk advisors operating on top of proprietary technology. Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.

Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

Why Join Us:

  • Grow Faster – We’re scaling quickly, giving you significant opportunities to learn, lead, and shape your career and the company's future.
  • Work That Matters – We protect the world’s most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.
  • Redefine an Industry – Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.
  • Financial Rewards – We hire the best and invest in you. That means competitive comp, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits. We believe strongly in internal promotion and lay out a plan for everyone's career growth.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own complex claims end-to-end across GL, Cyber, D&O, Property, and Marine/Cargo lines—triaging new matters, confirming coverage, coordinating carrier notices, and driving resolution strategies through to closure.
  • Serve as the primary client advocate, translating coverage and litigation issues into clear guidance, managing expectations, and aligning carriers, counsel, and vendors around the client’s best outcome.
  • Analyze and negotiate coverage positions, drafting demand and rebuttal letters, challenging denials, and securing optimal defense and indemnity contributions from insurers.
  • Oversee litigation and recovery efforts, ensuring defense and coverage counsel strategies align with policy recovery, and leading loss quantification for property, cyber, and other first-party claims.
  • Manage external partners and internal team members, setting standards for claims handling, mentoring analysts, and maintaining high-quality, audit-ready files and documentation.
  • Deliver insights and reporting through claims data, dashboards, and renewal narratives—identifying trends, coverage gaps, and opportunities to improve client programs and outcomes.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools, partnering with Operations and Product to streamline claims workflows, automate documentation, and enhance the client experience.

What success looks like:

  • Shortened claim cycle times and increased recovery/indemnity percentages (especially in the first‑party).
  • Fewer coverage disputes/denials through early positioning and escalations that stick.
  • High client satisfaction (clear communication, predictable updates, strong outcomes).

Who You Are:

  • Experienced claims professional with 5–10 years managing complex commercial insurance claims—ideally across GL, Cyber, D&O, Property, and Marine/Cargo—within a carrier, law firm, or brokerage environment.
  • Coverage-driven mindset with a J.D. and active bar membership; skilled in analyzing policy wording, drafting coverage positions, and advocating for insureds in high-stakes matters.
    Full-lifecycle operator comfortable owning claims from first notice through resolution, including coverage analysis, litigation oversight, negotiation, and first-party recovery.
  • Client-focused communicator who can translate complex coverage and litigation issues into clear business guidance, maintaining calm and credibility with executives during live incidents and negotiations.
  • Hands-on leader and mentor able to review and elevate team output, establish standards, and help build playbooks, templates, and scalable claims processes.
  • Analytical and process-minded, leveraging data, metrics, and technology to manage performance, improve consistency, and drive efficiency.
  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial, thriving in a fast-moving startup setting with strong judgment, humility, and a bias toward action and continuous improvement.

For candidates based in the United States, the expected pay range for this position at the start of employment is $150,000 – $190,000/year. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as market location, job-related skills, experience, and qualifications. This role may also be eligible for additional variable compensation, including quota-based incentives where applicable. WithCoverage offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package for full-time employees, which includes equity grants and a robust suite of benefits.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation that includes equity
  • Comprehensive benefit plans for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Pre-tax accounts (FSA, HSAs, dependent care FSAs, commuter savings)
  • Human Interest: 401(k) provider
  • Time Off: Flexible time off, sick leave, family and medical leave, major national holidays
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture

raw.description:
Amex GBT is a place where colleagues find inspiration in travel as a force for good and – through their work – can make an impact on our industry. We’re here to help our colleagues achieve success and offer an inclusive and collaborative culture where your voice is valued.

We are looking for a Sales Operations Manager to join our Sales Operations team as an individual contributor. You will directly own and drive high-impact projects across sales process design, systems, forecasting, and analytics. You will act as a strategic and operational partner to sales leadership, translating ambiguous business problems into clear, scalable solutions that improve the productivity and effectiveness of our go-to-market organization.


What You'll Do

  • Distill complex business problems and cross-functional processes into simplified, actionable requirements and solutions for sales and revenue leadership.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve end-to-end sales processes — from lead routing and territory assignment through pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, contracting and implementation.
  • Partner with key stakeholders across Marketing, Solutions, Account Management, Pricing, Implementation, Enablement and Analytics to ensure end-to-end continuity across the customer journey.
  • Build, maintain, and refine the sales forecasting methodology and cadence, partnering with sales leaders to improve forecast accuracy and pipeline visibility.
  • Lead territory design and account segmentation projects, using data-driven approaches to optimize coverage and capacity planning.
  • Create requirements for dashboards and analytics that surface actionable insights on pipeline health, rep productivity, conversion rates, and other key sales KPIs.
  • Optimize the broader GTM tech stack, including Gong, Outreach, 6sense, and ZoomInfo/data enrichment tools, ensuring these systems are integrated and adopted effectively by the sales team.
  • Identify inefficiencies in existing sales workflows and lead the design and rollout of process improvements and system enhancements.
  • Support strategic analyses and projects for sales leadership, including productivity benchmarking, win/ loss deep dive and territory rebalancing.
  • Partner with the wider annual planning team to determine pipeline/ coverage modeling, Headcount and capacity planning, Systems & process readiness, Plan communication and rollout.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a related analytical/GTM role.
  • Demonstrated ability to distill complex problems and business processes into simplified, actionable requirements and solutions.
  • Extensive, hands-on experience in sales process design, forecasting methodology, and territory design.
  • Advanced proficiency in Salesforce, with deep experience configuring reports, and dashboards to support sales process.
  • Practical experience working with Gong, Outreach, 6sense, and ZoomInfo or comparable sales tools.
  • Strong analytical and Excel/data modeling skills, with the ability to translate data into clear business recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have become a trusted operational partner to sales leadership — someone who can be handed a loosely defined problem and return with a clear, well-reasoned solution, backed by clean data and a scalable process, without needing to manage a team to get it done.

Location

United States

The US national base salary range for this position is from

$88,200.00 - $163,800.00

The national range provided includes the base salary that Amex GBT expects to pay for the role. Actual base salary will be based on factors including the scope and complexity of the role and the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, knowledge, and work location.

In addition to base salary, the anticipated range of which is posted above, this role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, which rewards participants based on company and individual performance.

For information about our comprehensive US benefits programs and eligibility, please review our Benefits-at-a-Glance document.

Benefits at a glance

The #TeamGBT Experience

Work and life: Find your happy medium at Amex GBT.

  • Flexible benefitsare tailored to each country and start the day you do. These include health and welfare insurance plans, retirement programs, parental leave, adoption assistance, and wellbeing resources to support you and your immediate family.

  • Travel perks: get a choice of deals each week from major travel providers on everything from flights to hotels to cruises and car rentals.

  • Develop the skills you want when the time is right for you, with access to over 20,000 courses on our learning platform, leadership courses, and new job openings available to internal candidates first.

  • We strive to champion Inclusion in every aspect of our business at Amex GBT. You can connect with colleagues through our global INclusion Groups, centered around common identities or initiatives, to discuss challenges, obstacles, achievements, and drive company awareness and action.

  • And much more!

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to age, sex, gender (and characteristics related to sex and gender), pregnancy (and related medical conditions), race, color, citizenship, religion, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by law.

Click Here for Additional Disclosures in Accordance with the LA County Fair Chance Ordinance.

Furthermore, we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the hiring process. For details regarding how we protect your data, please consult the Amex GBT Recruitment Privacy Statement.

What if I don’t meet every requirement? If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you’d be a phenomenal addition to our team, don’t worry about “checking every box;" please apply anyway. You may be exactly the person we’re looking for!
