raw.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents
  • Learning & Development stipend for employees
  • Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment + 20 days for 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!
In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

raw.description:
About Fusemachines

Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, United States, Canada, and Dominican Republic and more than 450 full-time employees), Fusemachines seeks to bring its global expertise in AI to transform companies around the world.

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required Skills / Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
  • LookML & Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.
  • Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.
  • Semantic Layer Implementation: Architect, write, and maintain LookML semantic models, reusable metrics, and self-service Explores/topics in Looker, Omni Analytics, or Looker Studio.
  • Data Parity & Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.
  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

If you are a senior data practitioner with deep experience across Tableau, LookML, BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic modeling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status.

  • 3+ years of experience in a technical consulting, ERP, integration, migration, or customer-facing technical role
  • Hands-on experience with integrations, APIs, XML/JSON, SOAP, extension frameworks, and both pro-code and low-code development
  • Practical, daily experience using AI tools in technical work

  • A team-player mindset and willingness to keep learning

  • One additional language (German, French, Swedish, or Dutch)
  • Unit4 ERP experience, especially with Extension Kit, App Studio, APIs, reporting, or migration tooling
  • SQL, Liquid, C#, PowerShell, scripting, or low-code development
  • Experience working in international project teams

Who we are

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated.

We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

  • a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact

  • balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits

  • growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work

  • talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry

  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme

  • a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

  • Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are

  • Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

Background check

This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your information safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.

At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters. — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.

We’re shaping how work should feel, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.

Agency Operations Manager (AI First)
CrucialPoint and Symby | Remote | Contractor | $18 to $23 USD/hour

About us
CrucialPoint is a retention and lifecycle marketing agency based in Utah. We're ESP agnostic. We run email, SMS and lifecycle programs for US-based DTC, CPG and restaurant brands on Klaviyo, Braze, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and more. Symby is our sister agency, a productized Klaviyo and Shopify service for growing DTC brands. Together we're a distributed team of about 30 and growing. We run an AI first operation across both agencies, and we're looking for someone to own the operations side.

The role
You'll work directly with the founder to roll out and run operational processes across CrucialPoint and Symby. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, and you'll do most of it with AI.

  • Turn defined processes into working systems: ClickUp structure, templates, checklists, SOPs, cadences
  • Build and run AI-driven workflows for reporting, QA, capacity tracking and task setup, using AI tools connected to ClickUp, Slack and our ESPs through MCP
  • Run the weekly delivery rhythm: what's due, who owns it, what's slipping, what's blocked
  • Keep the team on process and on schedule
  • Track capacity across the team so we know who has room before we commit to new work
  • Own onboarding for new clients and new team members so it's consistent every time
  • Flag early when something isn't working, with a proposed fix

Who you are

  • AI first. You use AI every day to run operations, you have connected AI tools to systems like ClickUp, Slack or an ESP through MCP or similar, and you can show us something you built
  • Hands-on email and lifecycle marketing experience. You have worked inside an ESP (Klaviyo, Braze or similar) and can tell whether a flow or campaign plan is right
  • 4+ years running operations, project management or delivery at a marketing or digital agency
  • Strong hands-on experience with ClickUp
  • Detail-oriented and driven. Things don't fall through the cracks on your watch
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Available during US Mountain Time business hours

How we work
Remote, Mountain Time hours, independent contractor. $18 to $23 USD per hour depending on experience. Part-time to full-time, with flat-rate structure possible once established. 90-day trial period with clear milestones, then ongoing.

raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Secret Clearance Required)
raw.excerpt: Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions.
raw.description:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

About the role

Our Mission teams operate like small startups within the Vannevar Labs umbrella. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will serve as the technical owner for a mission and its associated customer engagements. You will work directly with operators, analysts, and technical stakeholders supporting national security missions, owning the architecture, development, deployment, and fielding of software solutions tailored to real-world operational needs.

In this role, you will act as a senior technical counterpart to customer stakeholders — translating mission requirements into scalable software, navigating government technical environments, and ensuring capabilities are delivered reliably into production. You will collaborate closely with product, design, platform engineering, and mission teammates to deliver high-impact outcomes, while remaining a hands-on individual contributor.

What you'll do

  • Architect, build, and own software solutions deployed directly to customer environments in support of mission-critical use cases
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customer stakeholders, engaging with senior technical leaders to understand mission needs and represent Vannevar’s technical approach
  • Own end-to-end technical delivery for your mission workstreams, from requirements gathering and system design through implementation, deployment, and sustainment
  • Contribute hands-on code to improve product capabilities, performance, and scalability across customer use cases
  • Build software that enables users to unlock value from large-scale data holdings, including text, multimedia, and geospatial datasets spanning over 46 languages
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners — including engineers, product designers, and mission domain experts — to plan and deliver complex software features
  • Support government-facing technical artifacts as needed, including input to RFIs, RFPs, Statements of Work, and white papers
  • Navigate and integrate with government IT ecosystems, ensuring solutions meet security, compliance, and operational constraints
  • This is a fully remote role, but traveling is required - travel up to 20–30% to engage directly with mission owners and deliver capabilities in the field

What you should have

  • 5+ years as a Full Stack Developer including familiarity with relational databases (like Postgres), caching technologies (like Redis), object storage systems (like S3), and modern front-end frameworks (like React)
  • Experience developing and deploying software compliant with DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF)
  • Experience interfacing with government owned IT systems (for example, data platforms, IdAM providers, SIEM, CDSs, etc)
  • Experience working with government IT and program offices to scope technical requirements, architecture, and integrations
  • Experience working with end users to scope mission requirements, conduct user testing, and gain product feedback
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Must hold an active U.S. Secret Security clearance with TS/SCI Eligibility

What we offer

Competitive Salary

The base salary range for this position is $160,000 - $240,000. We hire engineers at multiple levels based on their experience, technical capabilities, and scope of responsibility. This range reflects the base salaries we typically expect to offer for this role, with individual offers determined by the candidate's qualifications and level.

Equity is offered in addition to base salary.

Comprehensive Benefits

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Remote friendly with WeWork access
  • Unlimited PTO, shared downtime during the federal holiday calendar, and company-wide off time at the end of each year
  • 401(k) match
  • Lifestyle & wellbeing stipends
  • Salary top-up during military reserve duty
  • Fully paid parental leave
  • Child and pet care reimbursement during travel
Vannevar is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the collection, extraction, cleansing and validation of commercial data across Ergomed, PrimeVigilance and ADAMAS, working with business data owners to resolve discrepancies and ensure reliable reporting inputs.
  • Prepare and deliver weekly commercial reports to agreed deadlines, highlighting key movements, trends, exceptions and areas requiring leadership attention at Group, business and regional levels.
  • Prepare and maintain standard monthly commercial reporting packs, combining validated metrics, performance against agreed targets, trend and variance analysis across all three businesses.
  • Design, build and maintain Microsoft Power BI data models, dashboards and reports, providing consistent Group-level views and business-specific drill-downs with appropriate access controls and reliable refresh processes.
  • Analyse commercial performance, including pipeline, business wins, conversion rates and performance against targets, to identify trends, explain variances and provide decision-useful insights, clearly distinguishing findings from assumptions.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to define reporting requirements, agree priorities and translate business questions into practical analytical outputs, balancing common reporting standards with the needs of each business.
  • Create executive-ready reporting and presentations in PowerPoint using think-cell, translating complex datasets into clear charts, concise narratives and consistent visual formats for leadership reviews.
  • Support market, customer and competitive analysis through targeted secondary research and available data, prioritising activities that inform commercial reporting and leadership decisions across the three businesses.
  • Maintain common KPI definitions, reporting documentation, data mappings, version control and quality checks; reconcile outputs with approved source data and document business-specific differences to support consistent, traceable reporting.
  • Deliver ad hoc analysis in response to leadership and business requests, clarifying the question, scope and deadline and communicating findings, assumptions and limitations clearly without compromising scheduled reporting commitments.
  • Work collaboratively across Business Development, Marketing, Finance, Operations and relevant systems teams across businesses and regions to align reporting inputs, validate interpretation and support adoption of reporting tools.
  • Drive the agreed modernisation of existing reporting, moving manual and fragmented outputs towards scalable Power BI dashboards, automated data preparation and reusable executive reporting templates; test and validate changes before transition and document improvements.
  • Follow applicable requirements for data access, confidentiality, data protection and appropriate data use.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience in data analytics, reporting or business intelligence.

Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in commercial data analysis, reporting or business intelligence, including hands-on development of Power BI dashboards and preparation of recurring management reports.

Experience producing executive reporting and presentations using PowerPoint and think-cell. Experience supporting stakeholders across multiple businesses, regions or functions and improving manual reporting processes. Experience in life sciences or a professional services environment is desirable.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

raw.title: Data Center Construction Electrical Estimator
raw.excerpt: ABOUT WORLDWIDE MISSION CRITICAL Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget.
raw.description:
ABOUT WORLDWIDE MISSION CRITICAL
Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget. Founded on the principle that the right team of experienced data center professionals will deliver great projects, our ability to provide oversight for all aspects of a project sets us apart.

Summary

    The Electrical Estimator will serve as a critical member of the preconstruction team, providing leadership and specialized expertise for electrical scopes of work, including electrical distribution, medium-voltage distribution, site dry utilities, low-voltage, communications/structured cabling, and fire alarm. The Electrical Estimator will be responsible for initial market research, conceptual budgeting, cost estimating, change order forensics, and buyout support for these scopes, working in concert with the Lead Estimator and Mechanical Estimator to deliver complete, well-coordinated project budgets.

Primary Responsibilities

    Market Research & Analysis

  • Conduct regionally-specific market research on electrical systems, including labor availability for electrical trades, commodity trends for copper, aluminum, conduit, and switchgear, equipment lead times for long-lead items (generators, switchgear, transformers, UPS, medium-voltage gear, busway), and other factors affecting costs.

  • Maintain detailed records of historical project costs, including labor, materials, and equipment.

  • Analyze historical data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for cost optimization.

    • Conceptual Budgeting & Cost Estimation

  • Develop conceptual budgets for electrical scope elements based on market analysis and project scope.

  • Prepare detailed estimates for labor, materials, and equipment, factoring in project complexity and location.

  • Generate cost variance reports at major design milestones to track trends, inform stakeholder decisions, and identify value-engineering opportunities.

  • Lead and support takeoffs using Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, LiveCount or similar tools.

  • Lead in the analysis of subcontractor, vendor, and OEM pricing for electrical distribution, generators, switchgear, UPS, medium-voltage distribution, site dry utilities, low-voltage/security, communications, and fire alarm scopes of work.

    • Cost Reconciliation and Change Order Support

  • Collaborate with general contractors and trade-partners to reconcile project costs and ensure scope alignment.

  • Provide support for change order forensics and perform cost reconciliation with trade-partners as needed to verify pricing accuracy.

    • Constructability Reviews and Value Engineering

  • Conduct thorough constructability reviews focused on electrical, medium-voltage, low-voltage, communications, and fire alarm scopes to identify potential challenges and improvements in design, including coordination of electrical systems with the building structure, mechanical systems, and architecture.

  • Work with project stakeholders to implement value-engineering solutions that optimize efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

  • Evaluate alternative materials, methods, and technologies to enhance constructability and reduce long-term maintenance expenses.

    • Trade Procurement & Buyout Oversight

  • Contribute electrical scope requirements and specifications to WWMC-prepared RFP documentation for general contractor (GC) procurement, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and complete scope coverage.

  • Provide review-and-assist oversight of the GC-led buyout of electrical trade partners, reviewing bid packages across electrical distribution, medium-voltage, site dry utilities, low-voltage/security, communications, and fire alarm for completeness and alignment with the project scope.

  • Review and assist with bid-leveling, analyzing trade-partner proposals to normalize pricing and identify scope gaps, exclusions, and pricing anomalies.

  • Participate in GC and trade-partner selection meetings, offering independent input on firm suitability, qualifications, and cost competitiveness.

  • Assist with pre-bid RFIs and site walks by reviewing responses and flagging issues relevant to electrical scopes.

  • Provide oversight of the GC-led post-bid interview and negotiation process, validating assumptions and confirming pricing accuracy on the owner's behalf.

  • Occasional travel to project sites for kick-offs, pre-bid walks, and constructability reviews.

Skills, Knowledge, Education, and Experience

  • 5+ years of estimating experience with a strong emphasis on electrical, medium-voltage, low-voltage, communications, and fire alarm scopes in mission-critical, data center, or other heavy industrial projects.

  • Proven ability to estimate projects $50M+ in total electrical contract value.

  • Ability to perform quantity takeoffs for electrical distribution and conduit/feeders, equipment (generators and switchgear, UPS, etc), medium-voltage distribution, site dry utilities, structured cabling/low-voltage, communications, and fire alarm systems.

  • Proficiency with estimating software (Accubid, or similar) and Microsoft Excel.

  • Solid understanding of data center-specific electrical challenges, including critical power topologies, redundancy concepts, and the ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, and specifications.

  • Familiarity with electrical equipment lead times and procurement strategy for long-lead items such as generators, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, and medium-voltage gear.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with the estimating team.

    • Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent estimating experience in lieu of a degree.

If you're ready to bring your expertise to a team that's redefining how data centers get built, we'd love to hear from you. At Worldwide Mission Critical, you'll find the support, trust, and room to grow that helped us become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country — and we're just getting started.

This role will lead the end-to-end testing strategy and delivery for large-scale data platform and cloud transformation initiatives, ensuring quality outcomes across complex enterprise environments. The successful candidate will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support the adoption of modern testing practices, including AI-driven and agentic testing capabilities where appropriate.

  • Proven experience in a Test Manager role delivering testing services across large-scale enterprise programs and complex technology environments.
  • Strong background in data platform testing, including data migration, data quality, ETL/ELT validation, integration testing, and analytics platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Azure Databricks, Unified Data Platforms (UDP), GCP, and BigQuery.
  • Experience testing enterprise data solutions across Master Data Management (MDM), Network Data Fabric, and modern data ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in test strategy development, test planning, execution management, defect management, and quality assurance governance.
  • Strong understanding of test automation frameworks, tools, and best practices, with the ability to drive automation adoption across programs.
  • Experience managing testing vendors, distributed test teams, and multiple stakeholder groups in complex delivery environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and reporting skills.
  • Ability to manage risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes while ensuring adherence to testing standards and governance requirements.
  • Exposure to AI-driven testing, intelligent automation, or agentic testing approaches would be highly regarded.
  • Experience supporting cloud transformation, data modernisation, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives is advantageous.

• Lead a team of 4 to 8 LIMS administrators, analysts and developers: set priorities, assign work, coach, and build depth so that no system depends on one person.

  • Define and execute rollout plans for new labs, business lines and acquired labs, including scoping, resource planning, timelines, budget and risk.
  • Work with lab leaders, super users and IT teams to gather requirements, configure and test the system, and run user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Standardize LIMS configuration and processes across sites while meeting necessary local requirements.
  • Run change control, releases and environments (development, test, production), including testing of vendor releases before they go live.
  • Partner with the Validation and Compliance team so that changes are validated and released in line with GxP, ISO/IEC 17025, 21 CFR Part 11 and client requirements, and that data integrity is maintained.
  • Manage the LIMS vendor relationship day to day: support cases, enhancement requests, statements of work, service level agreements (SLAs) and product roadmap input. Raise commercial and contract issues to IT leadership.
  • Own LIMS integrations with instruments, ERP, reporting and client data deliverables (EDDs), working with the application development teams.
  • Ensure documentation is created and maintained for all LIMS configurations, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, training materials and knowledge articles.
  • Report status, risks and service metrics to IT and business leadership monthly.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual review and reporting work, including the use of approved AI tools.
  • All other duties as assigned
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Laboratory Science, or a related field required.
  • 7+ years implementing and supporting an enterprise LIMS (for example Clinisys, LabWare, LabVantage, STARLIMS or Thermo SampleManager) in a regulated or accredited laboratory environment required.
  • 2+ years leading people or project teams required.
  • Experience with Clinisys CLS required.
  • Experience in an environmental, food, or contract testing laboratory required.

Also

  • Ability to manage and coordinate multiple projects in a fastpaced, highly professional environment.
  • Ability to lead, coach and delegate, and to build a team that can cover for each other.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of laboratory operations, including setting up test schemes/methods, product specifications, quality control (QC) templates, and stability protocol management within a LIMS.
  • Proven ability to define and execute complex, multi-site, multibusiness system rollout strategies.
  • Demonstrated project management expertise.
  • Excellent leadership, mentoring, and communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business requirements across diverse regional teams.
  • Familiarity with validation procedures and regulatory compliance in a GxP and ISO/IEC 17025 environment.
  • Strong understanding of laboratory workflows and their translation into system configuration.
  • Experience with system integrations (e.g., LIMS to ERP, LIMS to instrumentation).
  • Working knowledge of SQL and reporting tools.
  • Experience running support through an ITSM tool such as ServiceNow.

Compensation

We care deeply about transforming lives with AMD technology to enrich our industry, our communities and the world. Underpinning our mission is the AMD culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges. We strive for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative and inclusive of diverse perspectives. This is who we are at our best. One Company. One Team.

AMD together we advance_

Wired and Wireless Product Applications Engineer

THE ROLE:
The person in the role of Product Applications Engineer (PAE) provides technical support for Xilinx FPGAs, SoCs, and ACAPs as well as the associated Xilinx tools, software drivers, and IP. The PAE works with customers, field engineers, technical marketing, and factory engineers in a worldwide team to rapidly resolve complex technical issues. The PAE enables customers to complete their designs and recommends improvements to AMD products. The environment is fast moving with a focus on emerging technologies.

THE PERSON:
The ideal candidate has experience or a shown interest in designing / debugging high-speed wired and wireless interfaces. A candidate in this position will have the opportunity to work with everything from signal integrity and PCB design all the way through Linux/Baremetal application stacks. A successful PAE is hungry to learn and is able dive into projects, learning as they go. Excellent written/spoken communication skills and a commitment to teamwork are vital to debugging challenging issues as a cross-functional team, and interfacing effectively with end-users.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide direct technical support to multiple customers on critical design issues with a focus on Wired and Wireless interfaces, IP, and Software
  • Collaborate with cross functional team members to identify customer problems and propose appropriate solutions
  • Advise customers on design techniques and the implementation of alternative solutions
  • Develop tactical projects to explain or demonstrate product features
  • Generate self-support materials including application notes, reference designs, and answer records
  • Analyze customer cases and use data to influence product improvements
  • Identify gaps in products, provide test cases and work with engineering to resolve

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstrated proficiency in C
  • Experience with the Linux Kernel, networking drivers, and Baremetal Embedded SW applications
  • Demonstrated debug of complex issues using common lab tools including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and/or in-system debuggers
  • Experience with FPGA based design, PCB design and/or hardware validation

raw.title: Claims Customer Service Manager
raw.excerpt: about us: battleface is building a humanity-focused travel insurance company to bring people and the world together.
raw.description:
about us: battleface is building a humanity-focused travel insurance company to bring people and the world together. For too long, travel insurance has centered on the company and not the traveler. We're changing that by connecting people with customized coverage at the right price, exactly when and where they need it.

Our global assistance arm, Robin Assist, powers the 24/7 support, medical coordination, and claims services that travelers rely on — not just for battleface, but across the industry. Together, we're setting new standards for how travelers are cared for worldwide.

about the role: we're looking for an experienced Claims Customer Service Manager to lead, develop, and oversee our customer service operations within the claims department.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who understands travel insurance claims, knows how to manage people, and is comfortable working with technology across multiple communication platforms.

Our customers contact us during some of the most stressful moments of their travels. We need someone who can ensure they receive accurate information, timely responses, and professional, empathetic support. Whether they're contacting us by telephone, email, or live chat.

The right person will bring credibility, accountability, and structure to the team. You'll be responsible for developing our people, improving service standards, identifying operational gaps, and ensuring that technology helps us deliver a better customer experience.

We're looking for a leader who can make decisions, solve problems independently, and take ownership of results. This isn't a role for someone who simply monitors performance reports. We need someone who understands the work, can coach others through complex situations, and isn't afraid to get involved when needed.

what you'll do:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and manage the Claims Customer Service team, providing day-to-day oversight, direction, and support.
  • Establish clear expectations around service quality, productivity, professionalism, and accountability.
  • Develop and deliver structured onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching programs.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, quality assessments, and individual development sessions.
  • Identify knowledge gaps and provide practical training to improve team performance.
  • Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and scheduling to maintain appropriate service coverage.

Customer Service Operations

  • Oversee customer interactions across telephone, email, live chat, and other digital communication channels.
  • Ensure consistent, accurate, and timely responses to policyholders, claimants, brokers, and insurance partners.
  • Monitor service levels, response times, call handling, case resolution, and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage escalated customer inquiries, complex claims-related questions, and service complaints.
  • Ensure customers receive clear explanations of claims processes, documentation requirements, coverage decisions, and next steps.
  • Coordinate closely with Claims Adjusters, Medical Assistance, Operations, and other departments to resolve customer issues.
  • Identify recurring customer complaints, service failures, and operational bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, case ownership, and follow-up across all customer interactions.

Technology & Process Management

  • Take ownership of the effective use of customer service technology, including telephone systems, shared inboxes, live chat, claims management platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Manage and optimize workflows across platforms.
  • Ensure team members are proficient in the technology required to perform their roles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, routing, case management, and operational efficiency.
  • Work closely with IT, Product, and Engineering teams to troubleshoot issues, implement improvements, and support new technology.
  • Help develop and implement AI-assisted tools that improve customer communication, quality assurance, and operational performance.
  • Ensure customer records, interaction histories, and claims information are accurately maintained across systems.
  • Develop clear standard operating procedures, training materials, and knowledge resources.

Quality Assurance & Performance

  • Establish and maintain a structured quality assurance program covering telephone calls, emails, and chat interactions.
  • Regularly review customer communications for accuracy, professionalism, empathy, and compliance with internal standards.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, including response times, service levels, first-contact resolution, quality scores, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
  • Provide meaningful reporting and recommendations to senior management.
  • Ensure customer service representatives understand the limits of their authority and escalate claims decisions appropriately.
  • Identify performance issues early and implement measurable improvement plans.
  • Maintain consistency in customer service standards across different teams, shifts, and geographic locations.

what we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in insurance customer service, claims operations, or a related financial services environment.
  • 3+ years of people management experience, ideally leading customer service or claims support teams.
  • Strong understanding of insurance claims processes, policy benefits, documentation requirements, and customer communications.
  • Experience in travel insurance, medical assistance, or insurance claims administration is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multichannel customer service operations, including telephone, email, and live chat.
  • Strong technical proficiency and experience managing CRM, contact center, ticketing, and claims management platforms.
  • Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into measurable improvements.
  • Proven experience developing training programs, coaching employees, and managing team performance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex insurance matters clearly.
  • Confidence handling escalations, difficult conversations, and sensitive customer situations.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Sound judgment, independent decision-making, and a practical approach to problem-solving.
  • Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

what makes you successful:

  • You're a credible leader who earns the respect of your team through knowledge, consistency, and accountability.
  • You understand that great customer service requires both empathy and operational discipline.
  • You're comfortable with technology and can confidently introduce new tools, improve existing workflows, and help others adapt.
  • You don't wait for problems to escalate — you identify them early and take action.
  • You can balance customer expectations with policy requirements, operational realities, and business priorities.
  • You know how to turn performance data into practical improvements.
  • You're comfortable making decisions independently while knowing when to escalate.
  • You lead by example and are willing to step into customer interactions when the situation requires it.

why join us:

  • We're building something different in travel insurance and assistance. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our Claims Customer Service team operates, introduce better technology, develop our people, and directly influence the experience we deliver to travelers worldwide.
  • This is a remote position with a global team. Flexibility, collaboration, and accountability are essential. Travel emergencies don't follow a 9-to-5 schedule, and neither does our commitment to helping customers.

raw.description:
Position Summary...

The Senior Machine Learning Engineer will lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable machine learning solutions that address complex business challenges, with a primary focus on building auto-research capabilities that automate model training optimization, experimentation, and evaluation to accelerate the ML development lifecycle. This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, production-ready models and data pipelines while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards. Additionally, they will provide technical leadership, mentor peers, and drive continuous improvement to enhance system reliability and innovation aligned with organizational goals.

About the team:

Our team develops foundational models tailored for Walmart’s e-commerce platform by leveraging large-scale user interactions to create rich representations of users, products, and search queries. These models enable scalable search, advertising, recommendation, and personalization solutions. Team members apply expertise in data science, machine learning, and software engineering to optimize model performance, training, and deployment. With a strong focus on data quality, advanced analytics, and impactful visualization, the team delivers actionable insights that influence key business outcomes. Cross-functional collaboration drives innovation and continuous improvement in a dynamic technology environment.

What you'll do...

  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and product teams to deliver machine learning features and models.
  • Design and develop auto-research capabilities that automate model training, optimization, experimentation, and evaluation, enabling AI agents to iteratively tune hyperparameters and run experiments against defined objective metrics.
  • Surface the best-performing models with minimal manual intervention, accelerating the overall machine learning development lifecycle.
  • Implement, test, and support machine learning services, APIs, and data pipelines, ensuring quality and reliability.
  • Apply MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model versioning, and automated retraining, to sustain performance.
  • Conduct rigorous model evaluation, monitoring, and maintenance to address model drift and performance issues.
  • Ensure secure, compliant machine learning engineering aligned with enterprise AI governance standards.

What you'll bring:
  • Proven expertise in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning systems using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages including Python, SQL, Java, and C++ to build production-ready machine learning applications.
  • Hands-on experience operating agentic or autonomous research systems.
  • Experience running automated experimentation against defined objective metrics through AutoResearch loops.
  • Experience with machine learning lifecycle management, including data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of MLOps practices such as CI/CD, model versioning, automated retraining, and telemetry to ensure system reliability.
  • Ability to implement secure, compliant machine learning pipelines that adhere to enterprise AI governance standards.
  • Demonstrated collaboration and mentorship capabilities within cross-functional teams to drive technical excellence.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see . Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.
For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.
